Cummins, Inc. (CMI-US)  
財報 FIRST TAKE —資料中心備用電力需求持續加溫，上修全年財測，惟 EPS 未達預期、股價短線承壓

個股基本資料： 
Cummins, Inc. (CMI-US) 
日期 2026/08/04 
收盤價 $635.96 
股價表現 
三個月報酬率(%) -3.16 
六個月報酬率(%) 5.01 
一年報酬率(%) 75.88 
交易資料 
市值(百萬) $87,755.53 
30 日平均成交量 1,014,506 
52 週高低 $356.92 - $737.76 
市場評等 
市場預估 12M 目標價 $786.18 
買進 15 
持有 6 
賣出 1 
資料來源：Factset，Bloomberg 
 評論及分析： 
本季財報遜於市場預期， 剔除一次性因素來看公司獲利 低於預期的幅度有所
收窄 。CMI 與 AI 和北美卡車強勁週期敘事綁定的公司來看本次表現不佳 。然
而，北美卡車業務整體強勁，且下半年展望明朗，EPA 的分階段實施⽅案將
使 2027 年的過渡⽐預期更加平穩，從而降低卡車⽣產週期受到重⼤影響的
⾵險。資料中⼼發電和整合電⼒解決⽅案仍然是其成⻑潛⼒最⼤的領域 ，未
來超⼤規模資料中⼼將有數吉⽡的電⼒需求，其⼤型發電機組已售罄⾄2028
年下半年 ， 並預計從 2027 年開始將小幅提升產能，2028 到 2030 還有望實
現更⼤的成⻑。整體來看研判公司上漲題材敘事仍未改變。 
公司財報重點數據： 
2Q26 營收 95 億美元，年增 9%，創歷史同期新高，EBITDA 為 17 億美元，
EPS 為 6.73 美元，惟未達市場預期。營運現金流達 15 億美元，創歷史同期
新高。本季透過股票回購 2.25 億美元與現金股 2.76 億美元，核准將季度股
息調升 10%，為連續第 17 年調升股息。 
公司業績表現： 
(1).引擎部門：營收 31 億美元，年增 6%。EBITDA 利潤率 12.5%，較去年同
期 13.8%下滑，主因研發與運費成本增加，但受惠於北美中量型卡車銷量增
加、中國營建市場需求及關稅回收改善部分抵銷。 
(2).零組件部門：營收 29 億美元，年增 7%。EBITDA 利潤率 13.2%，較去年
同期 14.7%下滑 ， 主因產品保固覆蓋成本增加 ， 但受惠於北美卡車銷量增加 、
中國公路及非公路市場銷量提升與定價轉佳部分抵銷。 
(3).經銷部門：營收創紀錄 33 億美元 ， 年增9%。EBITDA 利潤率降⾄ 13.6%，
主因薪酬獎金與運費成本增加，部分被電⼒系統銷量增加抵銷。 
(4).電⼒系統部門：營收創紀錄 23 億美元，年增 19%。EBITDA 利潤率由
22.8%擴⼤⾄ 24.5%，主要受惠於美國與中國全球電⼒需求強勁。 
(5).新能源部門：營收 1.45 億美元，年增 38%，主要受惠於電動動⼒總成與
電解槽銷售增加。EBITDA 虧損 6,900 萬美元，較去年同期虧損 1 億美元收
斂，反映先前推動的成本削減措施奏效。 
(6).區域⽅面，北美營收年增 8%，國際營收年增 12%，由中國帶動。中國營
收達 23 億美元，年增 30%，受惠於資料中⼼需求加速及公路、營建市場改
善 ； 中國中重型卡車產業需求37.8 萬輛 ， 年增24%，主要由非洲與東南亞出
口需求帶動；中國資料中⼼電⼒設備銷售年增 88%。

公司展望與產業前景：
(1).上修 2026 全年財測：總營收成⻑目標由原先 8%⾄ 11%上修⾄ 10%⾄
13%，EBITDA 利潤率財測中位數同步上調⾄ 18%⾄ 18.5%區間。資本支出
財測 13.5 億⾄ 14.5 億美元。
(2).北美重卡 2026 年產量財測上修⾄ 24 萬⾄ 25 萬輛，原財測 23 萬⾄ 25
萬輛，反映近期訂單動能強勁及車隊獲利能⼒改善；中量型卡車財測同步上
修⾄ 13 萬⾄ 14 萬輛，原財測 12.5 萬⾄ 13.5 萬輛。
(3).中國市場 2026 全年營收成⻑財測上修⾄約 15%，原財測約 10%，中重
型卡車需求財測由原先下滑 10%⾄持平 ， 上修⾄下滑5%⾄上升 5%， 反映出
口需求優於預期。
(4).全球電⼒系統營收財測維持成⻑ 15%⾄ 25%不變，惟管理層認為成⻑空
間主要受限於產能而非需求 ， 資料中⼼備用電⼒需求持續領先產業供給能⼒ 。
(5).礦業設備銷售財測由原先持平⾄成⻑ 10%，下修⾄下滑 5%⾄上升 5%；

售後零件財測微調⾄成⻑ 3%⾄ 8%。
(6).產品層面：計劃於 2027/1 開始限量⽣產 X15 發動機 ， 預計將於4Q27 開
始全面投產。並限量⽣產 X10 發動機，3Q27 全面投產，但具體⽣產計劃將
根據 OEM 計劃而定。下一代 B 平台則預計 2028 年 1 月上市。管理層認為
此彈性⽅案有助於平滑產業需求轉換，避免⼤幅搶購潮後急速降溫的情況。
電話會議 Q&A 重點摘要：
(1).EPA 法規對 2027 年展望的看法：預期 2027 年需求會較過去法規轉換更
平滑；下半年 EBITDA 利潤率將優於上半年及去年同期。
(2).經銷部門利潤率下滑：薪酬獎金對人⼒密集的經銷業務影響較⼤，明年薪
酬獎金將依目標水準重設，明年薪酬獎金相關費用可望減少約 2 億美元。
(3).電⼒系統財測維持不變：95 升引擎產能已於去年完成投資，加上中國需
求持續成⻑；⼤型發電機組已接近滿載，部分客戶轉向購買小型機組，但此
趨勢近三個月⼤致穩定。
(4)2027 年出貨能否延續近年雙數成⻑步調，引擎部門在新舊產品並行⽣產

期間對營運的影響：管理層表示與五月投資者日公布一致， 公司供應鏈將新
增 20 GW 產能，2027 年開始逐步貢獻、2028 年迎來更⼤幅躍升，並持續
遞增⾄ 2030 年；關於引擎轉換，公司過去未曾經歷如此⻑時間的限量⽣產
過渡期，法規彈性有助產業平順渡過新舊產品並行階段，客戶對現行產品需
求依然扎實，同時也對新一代 HELM 平台展現高度期待。
(5).電⼒部門增量利潤率優預期主因，2027 年引擎轉換期間是否可能出現搶
購：中國需求優於預期，同時產能爬坡效率與供應鏈配合順暢、定價執行到
位；分階段轉換⽅案有助降低整體搶購強度，雖預期仍會有部分搶購行為，
但將較以往法規轉換週期更為平順。
(6).EPA 2027 法規對新引擎定價與成本結構的影響，備用╱柴油電⼒積壓訂單
狀況：管理層認為新產品的動⼒系統仍是卡車價值提升的主要來源，新技術
價值獲得合理定價；研發費用因分階段轉換將維持在略高水準，但增幅不⾄

於達數億美元規模。備用電⼒市場持續呈現產能受限、需求強勁的態勢，美

同時逐步導入新產品。針對是否可用 Credits 抵免 NCP，管理層明確澄清
Credits 不能直接用於抵銷 NCP。
公司簡介、競爭對手與公司自身價值：
康明斯是全球柴油與替代燃料引擎的領導製造商，產品廣泛應用於重型與中
型商用卡車、非公路車輛及機車車輛，並同時提供動⼒系統零組件，包括濾
清產品、渦輪增壓器與燃油系 統。近年策略核⼼聚焦於電⼒系統業務，受惠
於全球資料中⼼與關鍵任務基礎設施對備用電⼒需求的結構性成⻑，加上北

美卡車市場景氣復甦，形成公司獲利成⻑的雙引擎。

Spotify Technology (SPOT-US)  
財報 FIRST TAKE —漲價紅利與規模效益顯現，營業利潤指引偏弱顯現 AI 算力成本投入的短期過渡期

個股基本資料： 
Spotify Technology (SPOT-US) 
日期 2026/8/5 
收盤價 $478.17 
股價表現 
三個月報酬(%) 9.11 
六個月報酬(%) 8.54 
一年報酬率(%) (27.39) 
交易資料 
市值(十億) $98,446.76 
30 日平均成交量 1,840,738 
52 週高低 $405.00 - $748.30 
市場評等 
市場預估 12M 目標價 $602.6  
買進 39  
持有 8  
賣出 0  
資料來源：Factset，Bloomberg 
 評論及分析 (Overall Summary) 
Spotify 在 2Q26 業績表現強勁，付費訂閱人數首次突破 3 億大關，達成歷
史性里程碑。受惠於強大的定價能力（ ARPU 年增 7.4%）與產品創新，總
營收達 48 億歐元，毛利率創下歷史新高 33.4%，營業利潤達 6.55 億歐元，
雙雙擊敗市場預期。管理層強調， Spotify 憑藉獨特的規模優勢，正積極透
過 AI（如大型品味模型  LTM、DJ、Prompted Playlist ）與加值服務（如  
Audiobooks+、Reserved 售票）深化用戶參與度與終身價值。儘管公司在
新興市場刻意增加免費用戶的摩擦力以推動付費轉換，導致本季  MAU 增長
略低於預期且第三季 MAU 指引偏保守，但其核心的付費轉換與自由現金流
展現了極強的韌性。整體而言，Spotify 正在證明其能同時兼顧 AI 大規模投
資與利潤率擴張，朝向 2030 年財務目標穩步邁進。 
公司財報重點數據： 
Spotify 2Q26 總營收達 48 億歐元（+15%YoY） ，其中 Premium 營收年增
約 16%（受惠於訂閱數年增 9% 與 ARPU 年增 7.4%） 。營業利潤達 6.55 億
歐元（營業利潤率 13.7%） ，高於指引預期的 6.3 億歐元。毛利率達到歷史
新高的 33.4%，較去年同期擴張 193 個基點，優於財測 30 個基點。自由現
金流（FCF）表現強勁，達 7.97 億歐元（+14%YoY） ，季末持有現金與約當
現金達 94 億歐元。 
公司業績表現： 
1. 付費訂閱破三億，新興市場策略調整：第二季付費訂閱淨增 700 萬，總
數達 3 億，超前財測 100 萬。MAU 達 7.77 億（+12%YoY），惟因公
司在部分新興市場調整產品與增加廣告負載以驅動免費用戶轉付費，導
致淨增 1,600 萬略低於財測的 1,700 萬。 
2. 加值服務與新產品變現力顯現 ：有聲書附加方案（ Audiobooks+）的
年度經常性營收已突破 1 億美元。針對超級粉絲推出的「Reserved」優
先購票功能與 Live Nation 合作，已促成近 10 萬張門票預訂，多場巡演
分配額度甚至 100% 售罄提升 Premium 的會員價值。 
3. 廣告業務自動化與 AI 工具普及：廣告營收年增 3%，其中自動化銷售管
道佔比已接近 40%（高於 Q1 的逾 30%）。活躍廣告主年增 60%，並
已有 7,000 名廣告主使用 Spotify 新推出的 AI 音訊廣告生成工具。

複委託報告 August 5, 2026

2
公司展望與產業前景：
1. 3Q26 財務指引穩健 ：公司預估  3Q26 MAU 為 7.88 億（淨增  1,100
萬），訂閱用戶達 3.05 億（淨增 500 萬），總營收預估達  50 億歐元
（+14%YoY）。預估毛利率因季節性監管費用微降至  32.9%（仍較去
年同期擴張約 130 個基點），營業利潤預估為 6.7 億歐元。
2. 長線利潤與 AI 投資雙軌並進：管理層重申 2026 全年毛利率與營業利潤
率 將 持 續 改 善 。Spotify 自 建 「Chirp 」 編 碼 引 擎 及 大 型 品 味 模 型
（LTM），證明公司能在員工數持平的情況下，透過對算力與行銷費用
的靈活調配，兼顧成本控制並推進 AI 創新。
電話會議 Q&A 重點摘要：
1. 新興市場 MAU 放緩與轉化策略：針對 Q3 MAU 指引放緩，管理層解釋
在印度、印尼等新興市場正刻意增加免費用戶的「摩擦力」（如改變註
冊流程、限制低階 Android 設備支援、增加廣告），以啟動「免費轉付

費」的變現槓桿。此舉短期會影響  MAU 增速，但長期將帶來可觀的營
收潛力且無損近期的付費訂閱成長。
2. AI 產品生態與成本優勢：管理層表示，其大型品味模型（LTM）建構於
開源模型之上，並透過平台每日 3.4 兆次互動數據進行訓練，使 AI 推薦
（如 Autoplay 帶動活躍天數增加）與生成功能（如 Prompted Playlist
已獲  1,400 萬用戶使用）效益顯著。此外，算力與行銷等營運費用
（OpEx）屬可控變動成本，預期 Q4 的費用增速將會放緩。
3. 廣告復甦與混音（ Remix ）授權擴 ：管理層重申看好廣告業務將於
2026 下半年邁向雙位數成長。針對業界關注的混音與翻唱功能，
Spotify 宣布與涵蓋 3 萬家獨立廠牌的數位授權夥伴 Merlin 達成協議，
確保藝術家能在 AI 時代掌握授權同意權、並獲得合法報酬。
公司簡介：
Spotify 總部位於瑞典斯德哥爾摩，為全球規模最大且最具技術引領力的訂
閱制音訊串流龍頭。憑藉優異的「營運效率優化與雙邊市場獲利能力」 ，

Spotify 坐擁超過 7.6 億的全球月活躍用戶（MAU） ，展現出極強的用戶留存
與商業化轉化。
競爭對手與公司自身價值：
在 競 爭 格 局 上 ，Spotify 主 要 面 臨 來 自 蘋果（ Apple Music ） 、 亞 馬 遜
（Amazon Music ）在智慧家居與  Prime 會員綑綁上的低價滲透，以及
YouTube Music 對 Z 世代注意力的爭奪。Spotify 的核心優勢在於其業界領
先的 AI 個性化推薦算法以及跨平台的適配性；其在用戶發現新內容的效率
與社群黏著度上長期蟬聯第一。

元富證券投資顧問股份有限公司 台北市敦化南路二段 97 號 19 樓 (02)2325-3299  (1 15)金管投顧新字第 016 號 
公司拜訪快報

華邦電(2344) 
建議：維持買進 
結論：今明年獲利持續上修，並啟動高雄廠擴產計畫

一、華邦電為利基型記憶體製造廠，可根據產業市況彈
性調整 DRAM 和 Flash 產能分配  
華邦電合併營收包含記憶體業務以及新唐(持股 52%)，
就記憶體業務營收結構而言，Flash 和 CMS(Specialty 
DRAM)業務分別占 2Q26 營收比重為 61%以及 39%。
以產品應用而言，通訊電子、電腦、消費性電子、車用
及工業用分別占 2Q26 記憶體業務 28%、15%、28%、
28%，其中以通訊營收+74%QoQ 表現最佳。主要客戶
包含手機廠商、歐美日汽車廠以及 NB 廠商。華邦電
2026 年資本支出為 395 億元遠高於 2025 年之 55 億元，
其中生產設備約占 95%， 高雄廠年底月產能將由15K 提
升 24K，至於台中廠月產能則為 51-52K，其中 DRAM
將由 12K 降至 7K， 公司可根據產業市況彈性調整DRAM
和 Flash 產能分配。至於市場期待的 CUBE 以及矽電容
業務，推估明年營收仍難突破雙位數，公司定調此兩業
務將帶動 2027 年後新一輪成長。 
二、2Q26 EPS 5.4 元優於預期，3Q26 記憶體漲價趨勢
將延續 
2Q26 營收 598.4 億元(+56%QoQ)，成長主要來自於記
憶體業務，其中 CMS 業務 ASP 漲幅高於 Flash 業務，
毛利率 66.2%優於於前季 53.4%，營業利益 289.7 億元
(+131%QoQ)優於預估值 38%，業外認列收益 10.39 億
元，稅後純益 243.1 億元(+140%QoQ)，EPS 5.4 元優
於預期之 3.67 元。展望 3Q26，不論 DRAM 或是 Flash
漲價循環皆延續，估計 3Q26 營收 766.1 億元
(QoQ+28%)，受惠於記憶體業務出貨 ASP 持續上揚，
毛利率提升至 71.7%， 稅後純益338.3 億元(+39%QoQ)，
EPS 7.52 元。 
三、不論 CMS 或是 Flash 業務供不應求，且價格上漲
趨勢尚未看到終點 
在 CMS 業務方面 ，2Q26 CMS 營收+78%QoQ， 成長主
要來自價格上漲。AI GPU/CPU/ASIC 驅動的 HBM、
DDR5 和 LP DDR5 需求大幅成長，AI 基礎建設則帶動
eSSD、SmartNIC 與 BMC 採用更高規格 DRAM 因應高
速資料處理、傳輸和系統管理要求，至於非AI 應用產能
受限，原廠對客戶擁有更佳之產品訂價能力。在產業供
給方面，雖供應商整體擴充產能，但產能規劃將搭配客
戶長約需求，並減少 DDR4 和 LP DDR4 等成熟製程產
能產出，產業供不應求將延續數季，集邦預估 3Q26 傳
統型 DRAM 價格季增 13-18%。2027 年華邦出貨量成長
主要來自於高雄廠產能提升以及 16nm 製程轉換效益，
至於應用需求則以 eSSD 最為看好，可望占華邦 CMS
業務 10%營收。 
在 Flash 業務上，2Q26 Flash 營收+65%QoQ，量價皆
較上季成長。最新世代 AI 機櫃 NOR Flash 用量高達
500-600 顆，華邦市占高達 40-50%，AI 應用為 High 
Density 出貨成長最佳領域，至於 SLC NAND 除受惠於
國際大廠退出 2D NAND 市場，以及eMMC 供不應求致
使客戶回頭採購 SLC Flash，價格漲勢以及毛利率皆優
於 NOR。 華邦2027 年 Flash 產能將由 40K 提升至 50K，
位元成長上看 40%+並優於今年之 20%+，其中 SLC 
NAND 出貨成長性將優於 NOR Flash，公司冀望挑戰
SLC NAND 市占龍頭目標。 
四、高雄廠將啟動 Module B 投資，2029 年產能開出 
由於目前 DRAM 供給極為吃緊 ， 即便明年高雄廠產能提
升至 24K 仍無法滿足客戶需求，已有大量客戶想與公司
簽訂 LTA，故高雄廠將啟動 Module B 擴建計畫，2027
年 1 月動工，目標於 2029 年初導入設備，2029 年中開
始試產 ，2029 年底量產 ， 並投入12nm、14nm 和 16nm，
依照無塵室空間，整個投資計畫至多可新增 50-60K 投
片產能，但第一階段僅先安裝 10-20K 產能，EUV 需待
第二階段擴產才會導入，Module B 產能已有客戶洽談
LTA。此外，公司表示目前出貨以季合約價為主，並未
皆露 LTA 客戶營收占比。 
五、維持買進理由 
1)預估 2026 年和 2027 年 EPS 分別上修至 24.43 元和
47.63 元 
2)考量今明年獲利持續上修，並啟動高雄廠擴產計畫，
維持買進評等，TP 225 元( 2027 PBR x 2.6)。

2344 華邦電(Winbond)

報告日期： 2026/08/07  研 究 員：翁浩軒 (Davy Wong) 
壹、投 資 建 議

一. 2Q26 毛利率優於預期，EPS 5.4 元 
華邦電 2Q26 營收 598.43 億(QoQ+56.44%、YoY+184.72%)，其中記
憶體事業營收 517 億(QoQ+72.8%、YoY+303.1%)，2Q26 毛利率大
幅跳升至 66.25%，主要因記憶體價格上漲，營業費用提升 28 億主
要因提列員工獎金，稅後淨利 243.17 億，EPS 5.4 元。

二.  2026 記憶體維持上漲格局，預估 EPS 23.68 元 
展望 2026 下半年，預估記憶體求維持強勁下，價格持續上漲，唯
因價格基期已高，加上傳統消費性產品追價力道有限，漲幅不若
上半年，不過預估今年隨著價格上漲，加上製程轉換帶動位元出
貨量增加，營收逐季成長，預估華邦電 2026 年營收 2578.49 億
(YoY+188.4%) ， 稅後淨利 1065.38 億(YoY+2589.04%) ， EPS 23.68 元 。

三.  2027 年記憶體更加緊缺，預估 EPS 43.57 元 
展望 2027 年，AI 帶動之記憶體缺貨狀況延續，加上全球新增產能
有限，緊缺情況更加嚴峻。DDR4 在全球三大廠逐步退出下價格將
維持高檔，NOR Flash 及 SLC NAND 亦因供給端增產有限，價格逐
步回升 ， 其中 SLC Nand 因大廠退出 ， 華邦將成為全球最大供應商 ，
而應用於 AI Server 的高容量 NOR Flash 持續供不應求，預期將推
升價格上行至 2027 年。因應記憶體需求強勁，高雄廠產能將由現
在 15k 擴充至年底的 24k，屆時位元出貨量可望翻倍，同時啟動高
雄 Module B 投資計劃，規劃月產能可達 50k~60k ，將分階段擴充，
預估 2029 年底量產。預估 2027 年營收 4077.20 億(YoY+58.12%)，
稅後淨利 1960.56 億(YoY+84.02%)，EPS 43.57 元

四. 投資建議：買進，目標價 240 元  
華邦電為全球最大 NOR Flash 廠亦是利基型 DRAM 廠，AI 帶動各
式記憶體需求增加，產能仍供不應求下，獲利將逐季成長。公司
針對邊緣 AI 發展之 CUBE 解決方案將於 2027 年開始貢獻 ， 矽電容
亦為新的業務機會，中長期而言 AI、HPC、IoT、自駕車等新產品
新應用將帶動更多記憶體需求。考量到 1) AI 帶動之記憶體供不應
求將延續至 2028 年、2)華邦電今明年營收獲利創高、3)CUBE、矽
電容具成長潛力 ， 參考 2027 年 EPS 給予 5.5 倍本益比 ， 目標價 240
元，建議買進。

貳、公 司 營 運 概 況

一.公司簡介 
華邦電子於 1987 年九月由華新麗華集團轉投資成立，為自有品牌
IC 設計及製造廠商，並為全世界第五大 DRAM 供應商，且為國內
少數擁有晶圓廠之積體電路設計公司，同時也是全球利基型記憶
體的主要供應商。2008 年公司將邏輯 IC 事業分割成立新唐科技，
新唐產品線以消費性電子 IC 、電腦 IC 兩大產品線為主，並同時擁
有一座 6 吋晶圓廠。華邦電在 NOR Flash 為全球最大供應商，產
品上從中低容量市場拓展至中高容量市場。2Q26 記憶體產品營收
依應用面而言：消費性電子占 28%、車用&工業用占 28%、通訊電
子占 29%、電腦占 15%。NOR Flash 主要同業為旺宏、兆易創新、
Infineon。

二.2026 年營運概況及展望  
1. 2Q26 毛利率優於預期，EPS 5.4 元 
華邦電 2Q26 營收 598.43 億(QoQ+56.44%、YoY+184.72%)，其中記
憶體事業營收 517 億(QoQ+72.8%、YoY+303.1%)，主要受惠於記憶
體價格價格走揚，DRAM 營收季增 78%，其中價格季增 100%，位
元出貨量季減 10%; Flash 營收季增 65% ，其中價格季增 40% ，位元
出貨量季增 15%，產能利用率維持近 100% 。2Q26 毛利率大幅跳升
至 66.25%，主要因記憶體價格上漲，營業費用提升 28 億主要因
RD 費用增加，加上提列員工獎金，稅後淨利 243.17 億，EPS 5.4
元。市場應用別而言，通訊電子、消費電子、車用&工業用、電腦
等應用營收均較上季季增高雙位數。

2. 2026 下半年記憶體維持上漲格局，預估 2026 年 EPS 23.68 元 
展望 2026 下半年，預估記憶體求維持強勁下，價格持續上漲，唯
因價格基期已高，加上傳統消費性產品追價力道有限，漲幅不若
上半年，不過預估今年隨著價格上漲，加上製程轉換帶動位元出
貨量增加，及新產能貢獻，營收逐季成長，毛利率持續提升，預
估華邦電 2026 年營收 2578.49 億(YoY+188.4%)，毛利率 67.75%，
稅後淨利 1065.38 億(YoY+2589.04%)，EPS 23.68 元。

3. 2027 年記憶體更加緊缺，預估 EPS 43.57 元 
展望 2027 年，AI 帶動之記憶體缺貨狀況延續，加上全球新增產能
有限，緊缺情況更加嚴峻，而儘管終端電子產品需求不一，不過
未來 AI 落地後每單位產品之記憶體搭載量持續成長，使得記憶體
位元出貨提升 ，2027 年公司營運仍正向 。DDR4 在全球三大廠逐步
退出下價格自 2Q25 起漲，且因終端電子產品仍有一定需求，價格

能將由現在 15k 擴充至年底的 24k，屆時位元出貨量可望翻倍，同
時啟動高雄 Module B 投資計劃，規劃月產能可達 50k~ 60k，將分
階段擴充，預估 2027 年 1 月動工，2029 年 1 月裝機，2029 年底量
產。2027 年預估 DRAM 、NOR Flash 及 SLC NAND 價格持續上漲帶
動營收獲利成長，預估 2027 年營收 4077.20 億(YoY+58.12%)，毛
利率 74.52%，稅後淨利 1960.56 億(YoY+84.02%)，EPS 43.57 元。

4. CUBE 及矽電容為新成長動能 
AI 時代來臨，華邦電長期專注於利基型 DRAM ，針對 AI 將主攻邊
緣運算市場，邊緣運算之記憶體容量不需像 AI Server 那麼高，為
華邦電可著墨之區塊，因此華邦電提供 CUBE(Customized Ultra 
Bandwidth Element 客製化超高頻寬記憶體元件)解決方案，CUBE
具備超低功耗和超高性能、小尺寸、高成本效益，從而大幅提升
系統能力、回應時間和能源效率，以滿足邊緣運算平臺上快速增
長的 AI 應用需求。CUBE 優點在於 1)SoC 推疊在上面，散熱效果
較好、2) 可在 CUBE Die 上做穿孔(TSV)，降低成本、3) 3D 推疊
適合較小的終端裝置。目前華邦電與多家客戶開發 CUBE 方案，
預估 2026 年底開始貢獻，2027 年放量。另外因應 AI 晶片功耗劇
增、瞬間電流波動，以及先進封裝的空間限制，矽電容具有極低
的等效串聯電感與寄生電感，能在極短時間內補償電流，維持電
源完整性，避免電壓驟降，也彌補傳統 MLCC 的不足，華邦電因
客戶需求提供矽電容 foundry 代工，目前產能已滿載，未來 CUBE
及矽電容均為新成長動能。

股價相對大盤走勢

華邦電 (2344 TT)  Buy

記憶體報價續漲，建議 Buy。  
投資建議 ：AI 的發展改變產業追求性價比與記憶體單價的傳統 ，
轉而重視效能、算力及大容量。記憶體市場供需出現結構性改
變。進入 3Q26 DRAM 與 Flash 的價格仍維持上行趨勢，雖然價
格上漲趨勢較緩，但毛利率仍持續向上。預估華邦電 2026 年稅
後 EPS 為 24.85 元。除 AI 伺服器需求外，交換器及 Edge AI 應
用亦帶動 NOR Flash 與 SLC NAND 需求持續成長，華邦電憑藉
NOR Flash 全球市占率第一及 SLC NAND 擴產，可望持續受惠。
此外，公司矽電容目前產能接近滿載，受惠 AI 先進封裝需求快
速成長，將成為新的獲利來源。過去 3~4 個月產業雖歷經多項
利空干擾，但 DRAM 及 NAND 報價持續走揚，顯示供需結構未
見轉弱，對華邦電建議 Buy ，目標價 200 元 (PER8X) 。  
華邦電 2Q26 稅後 EPS 5.40 元：受惠記憶體報價上漲， 2Q26 華
邦電合併營收 598.43 億元， QoQ+56.44% 。 CMS( 原  Specialty 
DRAM 改名客製化記憶體方案 )占營收比重  53% 、Flash 占營收
比重  33% 、 Logic 占  13% ，其中  CMS 營收 QoQ+78.21% ，成
長最明顯。 2Q26 合併毛利率為  66.25% ，增加約  12.88 個百分
點。2Q26 記憶體的毛利率從  1Q26 的  56.6% 提升至  70.3% ，
1Q26 稅後 EPS 5.40 元。  
資本支出 395 億元 ：受設備交機時程影響，預估 2026 年資本支
出下修為 395 億元， YoY+618.18% 。部分原訂於 2026 年底交貨
的設備將遞延跨年至 2027 年付款，但整體擴產進度不僅如期，
甚至超前，來自製程的轉換。目前台中廠  DRAM 月產能約  
12K 。配合高雄廠  16nm 新產能於 2027 年開出，公司規劃於  
2027 年將台中廠  DRAM 月產能降至約  7K 。高雄廠  Module 
A 目前月產能約  15K ，預計在  2026 年底前提升至 24K 並開
始新增產能投片。 16nm 月產能目前約  2K 。華邦電已正式啟動
高雄廠  Module B 的全新階段擴產計畫，目標 2029 年年中開始
裝機，並於  2029 年底前進入量產。

目前台中廠  DRAM 月產能約  12K 。配合高雄廠  16nm 新產能於  2027 年

在  2026 年底前提升至接近 90% 。長期理想目標是將  16nm 產能拉高至

面積約  30,000 平方公尺，約為現有  Module A 的兩倍。完整裝滿後可容納
約  50K 至  60K 的月產能，但公司強調會配合客戶的預測與  LTA( 長期合
約 )採分階段裝機，不會一次裝滿。  
規劃生產  Standard DRAM 、 CUBE DRAM( 客製化記憶體 )、 Wafer-on-
Wafer( 晶圓堆疊 )及矽電容 (Si-Cap) 。 Module B 已預留 14nm 、 12nm 及

5 群益投顧 
圖一：華邦電記憶體資本支出

資料來源：華邦電，群益投顧預估整理 
華邦電在矽電容發展較預期佳：  
華邦電的矽電容起初並非獨立規劃的生意，而是華邦電在開發客製化記憶
體 (Cube) 時，為解決電壓驟降 (voltage drop) 而提供給客戶的保護電路。由於
產品規格極佳，部分非客製化記憶體的客戶進而主動要求試作，華邦電順勢
將其發展成一項獨立產品。  
隨著 AI、先進封裝 (如 CoWoS 等 )及細微穩壓 (1.2 伏、 0.9 伏以下 )的需求爆
發，矽電容因具備極小、極薄、耐高溫且電容值精準的特性，迅速成為解決
封裝雜訊與穩壓的最佳方案。  
華邦電矽電容的規格：目前正進行小量產的規格為  3,300 nF/mm ²，而最新
送樣的規格已達到  5,400 nF/mm ²。台積電的量產規格為 2,500 nF/mm ²(主
要用於其  interposer 上供客戶使用 )，其他同業則約在  1,500 nF/mm ²。華 邦
電在此領域具備顯著的領先優勢，並預期很快會成為全球最大的供應商。  
為避免矽電容生產擠壓到利潤更好的 DRAM 產能，華邦電特別為矽電容開
闢獨立的生產專線。公司先前已針對此專線投資約新台幣  40 億元，但產能
一開出便售光，目前高雄廠的矽電容產能已呈現滿載狀態，公司正積極尋找
新的空間進行擴產 。 由於矽電容的前景看好，目前已有數家原先製造  MLCC 
的廠商轉而進入此領域，並成為華邦電該項服務的客戶。  
相較於生產需要耗時 170 天的  DRAM ，矽電容的生產 cycle time 只需要 30
天。在相同的生產時間內， DRAM 跑 1 個生產 cycle ，矽電容則可以跑 5 個
cycle ，這大幅提升設備的周轉率。  
華邦電原本預期矽電容在  2027 年時能占  DRAM 營收的  10% 。然而由於
DRAM 本身的營收分母在近期成長得太大 ， 要達到  10% 的占比變得困難 ，
目前評估能維持  5% 營收占比。不過，矽電容發展的絕對總金額與公司原
先計畫的預期差不多，公司依舊看好其長期的成長動能。  
價格維持高檔，預估華邦電 2026 年營收 2,615.23 億元， YoY+192.51% ，稅
後獲利 1,118.29 億元， YoY+2,722.59% ，稅後 EPS 24.85 元：

6 群益投顧 
華邦電在 AI 邊緣運算方面，提供 CUBE(Customized Ultra Bandwidth
Element) 方案，並參加 UCIe 聯盟，華邦電自主開發高頻寬 CUBE 記憶體，
適用於邊緣 AI 應用， AI、 HPC 領域的  3D TSV DRAM ，華邦電目前 CUBE
在概念驗證 (POC) 階段，先在台中廠試做中，先以 25Snm 開發，後續會以
20nm/16nm 製程生產，可提供每顆晶片 256Mb~16Gb 容量， 2026 年有 16nm
製程， 2027 年可望貢獻營收， Hybrid bump WoW 可以推到 8 顆，再去切，
是以 good die base 出貨。華邦電之前與聯電 (2303 TT) 等合作夥伴成立晶圓
對晶圓 (wafer-to-wafer, W2W) 3D IC 專案，協助客戶加速 3D 封裝產品生
產。此項合作案聯電負責 CMOS 晶圓製造和晶圓對晶圓混合封裝技術；華
邦電導入客製化超高頻寬元件  (Customized Ultra- Bandwidth Elements, 
CUBE) 架構，用於邊緣運算 AI 設備，實現在各種平台和介面上的無縫部署，
但目前尚未出貨。  
管理層明確定位其角色更接近  ASIC ，配合客戶  XPU 進行  3D 封裝，使
華邦電與大宗  DRAM 商品市場的供給溢出效應脫鉤 。 一旦  CUBE 2027 年
起放量，公司的訂價邏輯將不再跟隨  DRAM 現貨市場起伏，而是依附在客
戶的  AI 晶片投資週期之上，這是一種更具黏性、更高毛利的客戶關係結
構。  
Code Storage Flash 方面， NOR Flash 供給在高容量終端需求帶動下持續偏
緊，推升價格於 1H26 起維持有利的上行趨勢。 SLC NAND 供給短缺態勢
亦升溫，支撐價格在  2026 年後延續上漲動能。主要成長來自  伺服器、車
用、 AI 相關應用。在消費端，隨  TWS 等應用功能複雜化，具備較小尺寸
優勢的  45nm Flash 持續推動  Design-in 。新產品自  2Q26 起， 24nm SLC 
NAND 將逐步帶來顯著的營收貢獻。    
Customized Memory Solution (CMS) 方面， DDR4 / LPDDR4 存在結構性供
給缺口，預期將延續至  2028 年以後，短期供給改善空間有限。在供給吃緊
及  AI 需求 (資料中心、 Edge AI 等 )挹注下， 2Q26 價格上漲空間明顯，對
2H26 至  2027 年維持正向展望。眾多客戶的系統單晶片 (SoC) 仍採用  22nm 
或  14nm 製程，短期內難以支援  DDR5 ，使  DDR4 需求得以延續  。隨著
三大原廠將製程升級至  14nm 以下，受限於  ECC 補償機制的技術差異，
已無法回頭量產  DDR4 。隨著大廠逐步淡出供給，現有產能已不足以滿足市
場長期的結構性需求，這正驅動  DDR4 與  DDR3 的合約價持續攀升，且
漲勢預期將一路延續至  2026 年底  。在應用端，智慧家庭、無人機、 M2M 
及網通設備在  2026 年的需求極為看好，電視相關應用需求亦維持健康。特
別是  20nm 製程在  2025 年呈現指數型成長，營收占比已達  55% ，這股成
長動能預計將持續貫穿整個  2026 年。  
過去簽  LTA 的主要是華邦電的直接客戶 (EC1) ，但 1Q26 管理層明確指出，
連二、三線終端廠商 (EC2、EC3) 乃至整車廠原廠，都開始繞過中間層直接找
上華邦電要求簽署長達三年的合約，部分  DDR4 客戶甚至提出 7-10 年的
超長期鎖貨需求。這種行為在供應鏈中屬於高度罕見，清楚說明市場對
DDR4 中長期供應的焦慮已從系統廠蔓延至整個生態鏈末端。對華邦電而
言， LTA 需求的激增提升營收能見度。  
Samsung 、 SK Hynix 、 Micron 陸續退出  2D NAND(SLC ／ MLC) 市場，將資
源集中於  3D NAND 高容量產品。這對華邦電而言，競爭者主動騰出的利
基空間，使其在  SLC NAND 的定價主導權顯著提升。 DRAM 端亦是相同

邏輯：三大廠將  DDR4 產能陸續轉向  DDR5 及更先進製程，導致  DDR4 
供應持續吃緊，華邦電的中小容量  DDR4 產品 (4Gb 、 8Gb 、 16Gb) 在
Enterprise SSD Cache 領域幾乎面臨無競爭對手局面。  
華邦電表示，進入 3Q26 ， DRAM 與  Flash 的價格仍維持上行趨勢，但管
理階層表示不預期 ASP 會再次出現單季 100% 的翻倍增長。 CMS 的價格將
大致跟隨市場報價進行調整。由於全球主要供應商逐步淡出  2D NAND 及
低容量  eMMC( 迫使約 15% – 20% 的低容量需求轉向  SLC NAND) ，在供給
持續緊縮且客戶強勁的設計導入 (design-ins) 支持下 ， 價格漲勢預期將穩定延
續至  2H26 。 NOR Flash 受惠於 AI 伺服器，單台新世代機架估計需使用約
500 – 600 顆  NOR Flash 、車用等強勁需求，高容量  NOR Flash 市場持續
供不應求，將推升價格上行趨勢至  2026 年以後。由於華邦電在  NOR Flash 
市場穩居全球第一市占率 (約  23%) ，公司表示會兼顧市場份額與客戶關係，
不會主動帶頭大幅漲價。  
華邦電基本不參與波動較大的現貨市場，主要採行季度合約報價 (quarterly 
base) 。所有產品全數以合約價成交、不走現貨市場，顯示公司對後續定價走
勢具有相當程度的掌控力。由於管理階層預期 2027 年的記憶體供應將會比
2026 年更加吃緊。公司在滿足客戶基本合約需求後，選擇在 2Q26 適度調
控與減少出貨量，將部分產品留到後續再出貨，以因應未來幾年產能吃緊的
市況並發揮最大商業價值。預估華邦電 2026 年稅後 EPS 24.85 元。

【投資評等調整機制】  
  投資評等係「首次」給予特定個股投資評等時，其前一日收盤價相較 3 個月
目標價之潛在上漲空間計算而得。個股投資評等分為四個等級，定義如上。
爾後的投資評等係依循「首次評等」，直到停止推薦。   
「強力買進」、「買進」及「區間操作」均有 upside 目標價。差別僅在於，
首次評等時潛在報酬率不同。「中立」則無目標價。  
一旦我們給予特定個股「強力買進」 、 「買進」或「區間操作」之投資評等，
就是責任的開始，爾後將透過各式研究報告作定期性、持續性追蹤基本面及
股價變化，直到停止推薦。  
停止推薦情境：  
1.  達目標價。  
2.  雖未達原訂目標價，但檢視基本面、訊息面、籌碼面等多方訊息，研
判股價上漲空間已然有限，將適時出具降評報告。  
3.  推薦後股價不漲反跌。

【免責聲明】  
  本研究報告僅提供予特定人之客戶作為參考資料「非經同意不得轉載」 。我
們並不確保此資訊的完整性與正確性，投資人應了解，報告中有關未來預測
之陳述可能不會實現，因而不應被依賴。而且此報告並非根據特定投資目的
或依預定對象之財務狀況所撰寫出來的，因此，此研究報告的目的，既非對
投資人於買賣證券、選擇權、期貨或其他證券相關之衍生性商品提供詢價服
務，亦非作為進行交易的要約。投資人應注意到相關證券之價值及收益，可
能會有無預警地上升或下降，產生投資回報金額可能比原始投資來得少的
情形。

摘 要 及 調 整 原 因 
➢ AI趨勢帶動 CCL 缺料漲價，26Q2 營收獲利雙創新高，EPS 27.6元 
➢ 高階材料放量、稼動率維持滿載，2026 年 EPS估 113.2元。 
➢ 2027 年 EPS 210.4元，考量公司在產業具有主導地位且未來幾年將持續高速增長，兆豐投顧
給予目標價 6945 元(33X 27(F)PER)，投資評等為「買進」 。

基本資料 結論與建議 
2026/8/4 收盤價： 5140.00 ➢ 台光電公告26Q2營收472.8億元，QoQ +43%，創單季
新高，優於財測，在產品結構改善與漲價效益帶動下，
毛利率跳升至33.9%，季增4.5ppt，稅後淨利98.7億元，
QoQ +84.9%/YoY +183.9%，EPS 27.6元。 
➢ 展望2026年，隨著AI Server 、高速交換器與 General 
server需求持續強勁，公司持續擴產以滿足市場需求，
此外由於AI Server 規格持續提升，高階材料佔比將逐
步墊高，同時BT預期Q4開始放量出貨；在整體產品組
合轉佳與漲價效應帶動下，預期毛利率將逐季攀升。綜
上所述，兆豐投顧預估台光電 2026年營收 1,941.7億
元，YoY +106%，毛利率33.9%，年增4.1pt，稅後淨
利405.4億元，YoY +176.8%，EPS 113.2元。 
➢ 展望2027年，隨著GPU與Switch規格持續提升，且CSP
持續擴大Capex，ASIC需求也上調，訂單能見度已達
2027年，亦積極擴張產能，預期至 27年底達產能年增
約50%，此外ABF CCL預期將帶來新一波成長動能，
故兆豐投顧預估台光電2027年營收3,209.5億元，YoY 
+65.3%，而毛利率方面，M9材料營收佔比可望由今年
個位數提升至雙位數，在稼動率維持高檔、產品組合持
續優化下，毛利率提升至36.6%，年增2.7ppt，稅後淨
利753.9億元，YoY +85.9%，EPS 210.4元。考量公司
在產業具有主導地位且未來幾年將持續高速增長，兆豐
投顧給予目標價6945元(33X 27(F)PER)，潛在上漲空
間35.1%，投資評等為「買進」。

營 運 分 析

台光電為全球銅箔基板龍頭廠  
台光電成立於 1992 年並於 1998 年市，總部位於桃園觀音，為全球最大無鹵
素銅箔基板供應商，AI Server 中 CCL 市占率超過 50%，同時是 HDI 材料
龍頭 。主力產品為銅箔基板 (CCL)、黏合片 (PP)及多層壓合板 (Mass 
Lamination)，不過自 2020 年起切入 IC載板材料(BT/ABF)之 CCL以作為第
二成長曲線，目前正積極推進客戶認證與產能擴充。

AI 趨勢帶動 CCL缺料漲價，26Q2營收獲利雙創新高，EPS 27.6元 
台光電公告 26Q2 營收 472.8 億元，QoQ +43%/YoY +110%，創單季新高，
優於財測，係因產品全線分批調漲以反映原物料成本上漲之影響，同時高階
產品 M7/M8 佔比持續提升所致，在產品結構改善與漲價效益帶動下，毛利率
跳升至 33.9%，季增 4.5ppt，稅後淨利 98.7 億元， QoQ +84.9%/YoY 
+183.9%，EPS 27.6元。

26Q3 高階材料占比續升、漲價效應完整反映，EPS 33.5 元 
兆豐投顧預估台光電 26Q3 營收 544.6 億元，QoQ +15.2%/YoY +116.6%，
延續強勁成長動能，主要受惠 Q3 全面採用新報價，同時在 ASIC 客戶與新
一代 GPU推出下帶動更高階 M8/M9 材料出貨佔比增加，同時在低軌衛星重
啟拉貨下將持續推升營運動能，受惠整體產品組合持續優化，預估毛利率提
升至 35%，季增 1.1ppt，稅後淨利 120 億元，QoQ +21.5%/YoY +202.5%，
EPS 33.5元。

高階材料放量、稼動率維持滿載，2026年 EPS 113.2 元 
展望 2026 年，隨著AI Server、高速交換器與 General server 需求持續強勁，
公司持續擴產以滿足市場需求，月產能預計 2026 年底增至約 615 萬張，年
增約 5%，此外由於 AI Server 規格持續提升，高階材料佔比將逐步墊高，同
時 BT 材料已開始認證，預期 Q4 開始放量出貨；原物料方面，研究部認為
高階 CCL缺料格局將延續，而公司亦持續分階段調漲報價因應原物料成本上
升，在整體產品組合轉佳與漲價效應帶動下，預期毛利率將逐季攀升。綜上
所述，兆豐投顧預估台光電 2026 年營收 1,941.7 億元，YoY +106%，毛利
率 33.9%，年增 4.1pt，稅後淨利 405.4 億元，YoY +176.8%，EPS 113.2
元。

展望 2027 年，隨著 GPU 與 Switch 規格持續提升，帶動 PCB/CCL 層數與
尺寸持續提升，且 CSP持續擴大 Capex，ASIC需求也繼續上調，目前公司
訂單能見度已達 2027 年，亦積極擴張產能，預期至 27 年底達月產能 930
萬張目標，年增約 50%，將有助於公司持續高速增長，此外 ABF CCL 隨著
新產能於 26Q4 建置完畢下與客戶驗證過後，預期將帶來新一波成長動能，
故兆豐投顧預估台光電 2027 年營收 3,209.5 億元，YoY +65.3%，而毛利率
方面，預期在新一代 GPU 推出，同時 Switch 亦升級至 3.2T 下，M9 材料營
收佔比可望由今年個位數提升至雙位數，在稼動率維持高檔、產品組合持續
優化下，毛利率提升至 36.6%，年增 2.7ppt，稅後淨利 753.9 億元，YoY 
+85.9%，EPS 210.4元。

台光電 (2383 TT) 
高速 CCL 王者，2026-2028 年獲利高速成長

永豐觀點 
台光電通吃 ASIC AI Server 訂單，高階料號市占率 38.6%全球第一，2Q26 毛利
率創高令人驚艷，中線在 800G、1.6T Switch 產品週期推升下 2026 年獲利持續
創高，長線 M9 料號貢獻，2026-2028 年獲利高速成長。 
 投資評價與建議 
台光電在 AI Server 接單無虞下產能吃緊，2Q26 毛利率創高來到 33.9%優於預
期，，長線而言M9 於 2H26 貢獻營運規格升級趨勢不變，公司亦規劃 2028 年底
月產能擴充至 1110 萬張較 2026 年增加 80.4%，營運價量齊揚態勢不變，研究部
上調 2026-2028 年稅後 EPS 至 115.37、211.35 以及 339.22 元，投資建議維持
買進，目標價上調至 6340 元(30X2027 EPS)。

ESG 評析 
台光電企業永續評鑑整體為 B+等，於 SASB 產業永續議題與跨產業五大永續面向
平均得分分別為 B+等與 B+等。 
SinoPac+ ESG 評鑑系統評等

### Page 2

2

台光電為國內專業銅箔基板廠商，主要產品包含銅箔基板、黏合片(PP)以及多層壓
合基板，2Q26 終端應用為行動裝置(10-15%)、基礎設施(75-80%)、以及汽車/工
業/其他(5-10%)，過去公司主要強項在無鹵素材料以及手機 PP 配方，由於 PP 毛
利率高於平均且隨著 iPhone 滲透率提升帶動公司營運逐年成長 ， 公司亦積極轉型
往基地台、Server 等網通以及車用相關應用發展，並成為通吃 GPU 及 ASIC AI 
server CCL 供應商。公司下游客戶為華通、臻鼎-KY、欣興以及健鼎等終端客戶包
含 Samsung、APPLE、華為、Cisco，主要競爭對手為聯茂、台燿、Doosan 以及
Panasonic。 
2Q26 毛利率 33.9%創高，本業表現令人驚豔：台光電 2Q26 稅後 EPS 27.55 元，
優於研究部原先預估的 22.15 元水準，其中毛利率較 1Q26 增加 4.5 個百分點來
到 33.9%創高並優於預期 3.1 個百分點，主要原因來自稼動率維持滿載、產品組合
轉佳以及漲價效應，其中受惠 AI server 需求暢旺，基礎設施占比來到 75-85%，
帶動 M7 以上高階料號佔比從 1Q26 的 55-60%進一步提升至 60-65%， 即便6 月
第二次漲價未完全反映，本業表現仍令人驚艷。 
AI 需求撐腰， 3Q26 營收 QoQ+21.1% ： 台光電 7 月營收 192.07 億元
(+8.3%MoM，+129.4%YoY)整體 3Q26 營收達成率 33.6%符合預期，研究部認
為 3Q26 除了 AI server 需求推動 M7 以上高階料號占比提升至 65-70%外，6 月
份 漲 價 效 應 亦 可 望 完 整 季 度 貢 獻 ， 預 估 營 收572.44 億元 (+21.1%QoQ ，
+127.7%YoY)，毛利率在稼動率滿載及產品組合轉佳下提升至 35.5%，稅後淨利
128.83 億元(+30.54%QoQ，+254.3%YoY)，單季稅後 EPS 35.96 元(原估 25.37
元)。 
2H26 仍具漲價空間，上調 2026 年稅後 EPS 至 115.37 元：台光電基礎設施產品
線毛利率優於公司平均水準，其中 AI server 占 55-60%、General server 占 15-
20%、Switch 占 15-20%、LEO 占 15-20%，整體櫃間傳輸以及 Agentic AI 帶動
的 General server 等泛 AI 需求達 75-80%，展望 2026 年不論 GPU 及 ASIC 陣營
相關需求不墜，稼動率持續維持滿載，另一方面 M7 以上 CCL 在供給吃緊下擴產
能見度已達 2028 年，2H26 仍具漲價空間，研究處上調台光電 2026 年營收至
1942.72 億元 (+106.1%YoY) ，毛利率 34.3% ， 稅 後 淨 利413.36 億元
(+182.2%YoY)，稅後 EPS 115.37 元(原估 84.89 元)。

M9 於 2H26 問世 ，CCL 料號升級趨勢不變： 台光電於2020 年來積極切入 Server、
Switch 以及 AI Server 等高速傳輸領域持續侵蝕同業聯茂(6213 TT) 和台燿(6274 
TT)於 Server 及 Switch 市占，2023 年並成為美系 AI Server 首輪供應商，帶動相
關基礎設施產線於2Q26 達 75-80%，毛利率超越 Handheld 成為全公司最佳，長
線而言隨著 ASIC AI Server 以及 800G、1.6T Switch 產品週期推升，M8 比重將於
2025 年攀升，而M9 亦將於 2H26 問世並占比低個位數，公司產品組合轉佳趨勢不
變。 
AI server 需求強勁，擴產規畫達 2028 年：隨著 AI Server 於高速傳輸需求殷切，
不論櫃內連結的 Switch Tray，或者機櫃間連接的乙太網路規格皆持續升級，另外
Agentic AI 亦帶動一般 server 快速成長，以 AMD 預期 2030 相關 CPU TAM 達
2000 以美元以上計算 CAGR 達 40-45%，且 Oak Stream 新平台下料號升級至
M7，整體高階料號供給吃緊，以目前土建 1.-1.5 年，設備交期 0.5-1.0 年計算，
新產能最快開出時點落於 2028 年，預計 4Q26 大園擴增 30 萬張新產能總計月產
能達 615 萬張(+17.1%YoY)，2027 年在中山、昆山以及檳城產能擴充下年底月產
能達 930 萬張(+51.2%YoY)，2028 年年底更上看 1110 萬張(+19.4%YoY)，考量
規格升級以及高階料號潛在供給吃緊後台光電 2027-2028 年獲利成長具上調空
間 ， 預估稅後EPS 分別上調至 211.35 元(原估 159.73 元)及 339.22 元(原估 247.13
元)。

Airtac
Valuation
We derive our target price of NT$1,750 for Airtac by using a P/E methodology, as we believe the margin and earnings growth
outlooks will be the key drivers of the stock. We apply a P/E of 27.5x for 2H26-1H27E, which we derive from the mid range of
prior upcycle valuation 25-35x during 2021 in view of a strong upcycle with solid FA demand and ongoing share gains.
Risks
Key downside risks that could impede the Airtac stock from reaching our target price include: 1) a softer-than-expected China

macro economy, resulting in downside to our sales forecasts; 2) intensifying competition leading to gross margin pressures;
and 3) slower-than-expected progress of its linear guide business, causing low utilization of capacity.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also

Summary: Sinbon reported its monthly revenue for July 2026 of TWD3,167m (+2.4% MoM 
and +29.0% YoY; +11.4% YoY for 7M26), a record-high level, after market hours on 4

consensus estimates of 3Q26 revenue.

We have a Buy (1) rating with a 12-month TP of TWD365, based on a target PER of 21x 
applied to our 1-year-forward EPS forecast. For more information on the company, please 
refer to our latest memo (2Q26 results: slight miss on higher opex, on 23 July 2026).

What’s the impact 
• July 2026 revenue ahead of our and the Bloomberg consensus estimates. Sinbon 
reported a monthly revenue for July 2026 of TWD3,167m (+2.4% MoM and +29.0% 
YoY; +11.4% YoY for 7M26), a record-high level, and it accounted for 34.1% and 33.6% 
of our (TWD9,300m, +3.1% QoQ and +23.2% YoY) and the Bloomberg consensus 
estimates of 3Q26 revenue. We saw stronger YoY revenue growth in the medical, auto 
and industrial segments in July 2026. We expect its monthly revenue to see further 
record high levels in the following months.

Valuation Methodology and Risks
Unimicron (3037.TW)
Base case, residual income (RI) valuation model, which we think derives the most accurate
value of the firm given that it takes into account cost of equity. We use a cost of equity of 9.2%
[risk-free rate of 1% (10-year Taiwan government note yield), equity risk premium of 8.7%, and
a beta of 1.0], a medium-term growth rate of 15%, and a terminal growth rate of 3%.
Risks to Upside
n Better-than-expected ABF substrate demand from PC and server customers

n Capex cuts; halt to its capacity expansion plan
n Continued yield issues of alternative technology that doesn't require substrate (e.g.,
CoWoP)
Risks to Downside
n Sudden demand shortfall
n Technological change that would not require ABF substrates
n Intensifying competition
n Yield issues or production hiccups when ramping new capacity
Nan Ya PCB (8046.TW)
Base case, residual income (RI) valuation model, which we think derives the most accurate

value of the firm given that it takes into account cost of equity. We use a cost of equity of 9.3%
[risk-free rate of 1% (10-year Taiwan government note yield), equity risk premium of 8.7%, and
a beta of 1.0], a medium-term growth rate of 17%, and a terminal growth rate of 3%.
Risks to Upside
n Better-than-expected ABF and BT demand
n Faster-than-expected pickup in AI and 5G demand
n Stronger-than-expected ASP hike
n Continued yield issues of alternative technology that doesn't require substrate (e.g.

CoWoP)
Risks to Downside
n Sudden demand shortfall, creating headwinds for ABF substrate demand and pricing
n Technological change that would not require ABF substrates
n Intensifying competition

## Document 082: 260805_daiwa_ASPEED

Source PDF: all report pdf/260805_daiwa_ASPEED.pdf
Report source: line報告備份
Date: 2026-08-05
Pages: 7
Extraction status: ok

### Page 1

Taiwan Information Technology

What’s new: ASPEED announced its 2Q26 results today (5 August).

What’s the impact: 2Q26 results beat on higher GM. Net income was 
TWD1.84bn (EPS: TWD44.27), which is 9-18% above our estimate 
(TWD1.56bn) and the Bloomberg consensus (TWD1,68bn), respectively. 
Gross margin increased by 2.8pp QoQ to 72.0% (vs. 69.2% in 1Q26), 
better than investors’ expectation on price increases for its products to pass 
through additional BT substrate costs. Strength was slightly offset by a 
higher employee stock-based bonus in 2Q26. Net profit was boosted by a 
higher non-operational gain of TWD180m, which could be FX gains.

Business outlook. We believe most investors are worried about the 
overbuilt BMC in 2026, as they cannot see a significant jump in regular 
server shipments in 2026 (likely 15-20% YoY). We expect ASPEED’s BMC 
shipment volume to be at 30.5/36.1m (66%/19% YoY) in 2026/27 (vs. prior 
estimates of 29.4/34.7m), as we continue to see a better-than-expected 
quarter sales run rate. We expect solid regular server and AI demand 
ahead to provide market strength, although we consider some earlier pull-in 
in 2H26 given regular server shipment growth seems to be capped by a 
component shortage. We expect AI and non-AI servers to consume 
12m/19m of BMC shipments, respectively, in 2026 and 16m/20m in 2027 
due to a new CSP AI server contribution and a GPU client increasing its 
product offerings from the next generation.

Although the current run-rate for ASPEED’s BMC shipment seems to be 
higher than market demand, we believe the potential excess inventory 
should be less than 3m (<10% of shipment), in line with the historical 
pattern. We also expect ASPEED to maintain its positive tone on shipments 
in 2H26 given support from back-end OAST vendors from 4Q26 and solid 
demand ahead. We believe the GM increased in 2Q26 due to its own price 
hikes, but we expect it to gradually decline QoQ in 2H26 on ongoing price 
hikes by substrate vendors. Based on our understanding, ASPEED is still 
negotiating another round of price hikes for substrates for 2027. Hence, the 
GM dilution we expect in 2027 would be due to the AST2700 ramp. Before 
shipment meets critical mass, we believe the GM would be suboptimal.

What we recommend: We lift our 2026-28E EPS by 8-12% to factor in our 
higher BMC shipment assumptions. We lift our 12M TP to TWD19,800, 
based on an unchanged 66x PER (high end of its past-3-year range of 21-
78x) on our 1-year forward EPS forecast. Key risk: weak AI server demand.

How we differ: Our 2026-28E EPS are 2-3% higher than the Bloomberg 
consensus, likely due to our bullish view on ASPEED’s ASP and shipment.

5 August 2026

2Q26 results: gross margin a surprise

➢ 2H26 outlook remains promising with likely higher margins  
➢ Potential inventory build is still healthy and under control  
➢ Reaffirming our Buy (1) rating; raising our 12-month TP to TWD19,800

Company profile 
Established in November 2004, Aspeed is a fabless IC design company specialising in baseboard 
management controllers (BMCs), which are mostly used for the remote management of servers. Aspeed 
is a global leader in BMC, with about 70% market share. Its other products include PC/AV extension 
SoC, which supports the extension of digital signals of PCs or multimedia content to remote terminals; 
and Cupola360, which is a spherical image processor that supports 360-degree cameras.

Nuvoton Technology Corporation  | Asia Pacific
2Q turned loss-making again;
UW
2Q details:
• Revenue was NT$7.9bn, -1% Q/Q, +2% Y/Y, 5% below our estimate. The Q/Q
decline was from a supply chain issue rather than demand, according to
management.
• GP was NT$3.0bn, GM was 38.0%, -1.3ppt Q/Q, +3.1ppt Y/Y, 1.8ppt above our
estimate. The Q/Q decline from a high base last quarter is attributable to
inventory reversals.
• OPM was -4.2%, -2.8ppt Q/Q, -2.4ppt Y/Y, owing to increase in employee

compensation and R&D expenses in preparation for strong AI demand in
2027.
• Net loss was NT$249mn, turning negative vs. 1Q and worse than we
expected.
Business update:
• AI & computing segment revenue  declined to 31% of the mix in 2Q, vs. 35% in
1Q, mainly owing to weaker PC demand from memory price hike.
• Communication segment revenue rose to 20% of the mix in 2Q vs. 15% in 1Q,
reflecting  a high-end model launched by a major customer.

Valuation Methodology and Risks
Nuvoton Technology Corporation (4919.TW)
Base case, residual income model. We assume a 9.2% cost of equity (beta 1.2, risk-free rate
2.0% and risk premium 6.0%), a payout ratio of 55%, a medium-term growth rate of 7.0%, and

n MCU up-cycle is more sustained than expected.
n China's MCU localization is faster than expected.
n Traction from auto and BMC business is greater.

n Margin improvement is more significant.
Risks to Downside
n MCU up-cycle ends earlier with severe pricing erosion.
n China's MCU localization is slower than expected.
n Traction from auto and BMC business is less.
n Margins contract amid more intensified competition.

2Q26 results beat on stronger margins — Sales rose 21% y/y and 6% q/q to 
NT$4.8bn, 2% above our estimate, while net income grew 33% y/y and 20% q/q to 
NT$1.1bn, beating our/BBG estimates by 12%/16%. The key positive surprise was 
GPM, which expanded 3.0ppt q/q to 39.1%. We believe the improvement was likely 
driven by a better product mix, particularly a higher contribution from higher power 
rating BBU products, together with stronger fixed-cost leverage as shipment volume 
increased. The margins beat suggests potential upside risk to our and BBG full year 
earnings forecasts. 
July-26 sales provide further evidence of robust BBU demand — Sales reached 
another record high of NT$1.7bn, up 28% y/y and 2% m/m, extending the sequential 
growth momentum seen since March. The solid monthly performance following a 
strong 2Q suggests that demand remains healthy.    
Implications — AES's strong results and solid July-26 sales reinforce our positive 
view on the BBU sector, supported by sustained AIDC infrastructure buildout, 
increasing BBU content and an ongoing shift toward higher-power products. The 
solid GPM expansion is also an encouraging read-across for Dynapack, our preferred 
BBU stock. It suggests meaningful room for Dynapack's profitability to improve as its

Advanced Energy Solution
Valuation
Our target price of NT$1,680 is based on 27x 2026E EPS on par with its historical average since listing and supported by a
2025-28E earnings CAGR of 27%. We use 2027E as the year of valuation base as we think 2027E can better reflect its earnings
power after the commercializarion of HVDC products.
Risks
Key downside risks to our earnings forecasts that could prevent the shares from reaching our target price include: 1) slower-

than-expected end demand from e-Bikes post the pandemic and volaitlity in cloud capex deployment that could impact
datacenter BBU sales; 2) component supply constraints/logistics challenges, which could lead to slower-than-expected
shipment and top-line momentum; and 3) peer competition, which could impact sales growth and margins negatively, in our
view.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

Catalyst Watch and STV Upside/Downside calls: Citi Research may also include a Catalyst Watch or STV Upside or Downside
call to indicate the analyst expects the share price to rise (fall) in absolute terms over a specified period of 30 or 90 days in
reaction to one or more specific near-term catalysts or events impacting the company or the market. A Catalyst Watch will be
published when Analyst confidence is high that an impact to share price will occur; it will be a STV when confidence level is

moderate. A Catalyst Watch or STV Upside/Downside call will automatically expire at the end of the specified 30/90 day
period. The Catalyst Watch will also be automatically removed if share price performance (calculated at market close) exceeds

### Page 6

WT Micro (3036.TW)
06 August 2026 Citi Research
6
WT Micro
Company description
Founded in 1993, WT Micro focuses on semiconductor-related component
agency sales. Currently, it ranks among the top four IC distributors globally
and holds a market share of around 12%. Headquartered in Taiwan, WT Micro
has an extensive marketing and sales channel with nearly 50 regional offices
across China, Korea, Singapore, India, Thailand, Malaysia, and Vietnam. WT

Micro currently serves as the distribution partner to >25,000 customers for
over 80 global leading semiconductor partners. As of 2023, 28% revenues
came from mobile phone, 22% from datacenter, 14% from communication,
10% from industrial, 10% from PC, 9% from consumer and 8% from
automotive application
Investment strategy
We rate WT Micro as Buy. From a top-down view, we expect the IC
distribution industry to be aided by semi upcycle on AI in 2026. We also see

global supply chain relocation favoring WT Micro going forward given its more
diversified global footprints. For its subsidiary, Future Electronics, which WT
Micro acquired in 2024, we are seeing the merger bearing fruit given ongoing
recovery in auto/industrial business for US/European customers with higher
GM profile. Furthermore, we believe there is significant further potential from
synergies, primarily through cross-selling to each company's customer base

and securing new distribution rights in the U.S. and Europe.
Valuation
We use DCF methodology to derive our target price of NT$365. Key
assumptions of our DCF model include a risk-free rate of 4.1% (10-year
government bond rate), a market risk premium of 7%, and an equity beta of
0.9 (1-year weekly share price), which derives a WACC of 8.6%. Our model
assumes 1% long-term revenue growth and gradual expanding of EBIT margin
from 1.9% in 2028 to 2.3% in the long term. Our target price is equivalent to

13x/11x 2026/27E EPS and 3.3x/2.5x BVPS, which is in line with its peers'
valuation and we believe is justified by AI trend, upsides from its subsidiary,
Future Electronics.
Risks
Key downside risks that could prevent WT Micro’s share price from reaching
our target price are: 1) weaker-than-expected end market demand; 2) lower-
than-expected synergy from the acquisition of Future; 3) taking longer time to
acquire new distribution rights or 4) aggressive funding for its working capital

via higher leverage ratio (more interest expense) or GDR issuance (earnings
dilution).

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and

Catalyst Watch/Short Term Views (“STV”) Ratings Disclosure:

call to indicate the analyst expects the share price to rise (fall) in absolute terms over a specified period of 30 or 90 days in

Summary: Innodisk released its 2Q26 results and monthly revenue for July 2026, on 6 
August 2026 after market hours. The EPS was TWD108.93, beating our and the 
Bloomberg consensus estimates by 65.3% and 24.5%, respectively, which we attribute to 
memory price hikes and product mix improvement. We see an incrementally positive tone 
from the company on its order outlook for 2H26 due to favourable memory price hikes and 
rising AI application.

We have a Buy (1) rating on the stock with a 12-month TP of TWD2,385, based on a target 
PER of 10x, applied to our 1-year-forward EPS. For more information on this company, 
please refer to our flash, Record-high monthly revenue driven by flash price hike, beating 
expectations, on 6 July 2026.

What’s the impact 
• 2Q26 results: a strong beat. Innodisk posted 2Q26 revenue of TW22,443m (+70.3% 
QoQ and +641.1% YoY), a record-high level, beating our and the Bloomberg consensus 
estimates by 53.0% and 16.5%, respectively. Gross margin came in at 65.0%, also a 
record-high level (higher than 59.1% in 1Q26 and 25.9% in 2Q25), above our estimate 
(60.0%) and the consensus (61.9%), thanks to memory price hikes. Thus, its operating 
profit of TWD13,146m (+91.9% QoQ and +3,615.5% YoY) beat our and the consensus 
estimates by 67.8% and 21.6%, respectively. Its net profit of TWD10,368m (+89.7% 
QoQ and +5,493.8% YoY) beat our and the Bloomberg consensus estimates by 65.5% 
and 22.9%, respectively. Innodisk’s 2Q26 basic EPS came in at TWD108.93. Note 
Innodisk’s product mix for 2Q26 was Flash: 35%; DRAM: 60%.

• Much stronger demand over supply. Innodisk expects its revenue momentum to

range of 1-24x (average: 10x). Key risks: weaker-than-expected memory price hikes and

### Page 1

Chroma ATE

3Q26 sales tracking stronger; SLT/power 
business concerns unfounded

Maintain Rating: BUY | PO: 3,050 TWD | Price: 1,975 TWD

July sales booking 35%/39% BofAe/street 3Q26 estimates 
Chroma reported July consolidated sales +32% MoM and +175% YoY to NT$5.4bn, 
representing 35%/39% of BofAe/street estimate of +16%/+5% QoQ, much stronger 
than seasonal +32%. We believe the strength is led by its power testing equipment 
shipment to its China customers’ ESS battery capacity builds along with solid demand 
for semiconductor testing equipment across SLT with continued orders from AMD for 
GPU system level testing (SLT) equipment and its gains in CPU SLT. The growing 
contribution from its photonics business could see further strength through 2H26 on 
initial capacity builds for CPO pilot production and surge in optical transceiver demand. 
Market concerns on GMs, SLT and power specs overdone 
Investors post Chroma’s earnings call on July 30th are concerned on 1) its GMs/OpMs 
trend into 2H26 following a slight disappointment in 2Q26,  we believe the 
company should see another round of operating leverage as it passes the material 
inflationary cost to its customers and stronger than feared sales trend in 2H26 as 
witnessed in July , 2) its SLT opportunity in AMD CPU:  we expect Chroma and Hon 
Precision to be in charge of different SKU of the products which is not reflected in 
current street expectations,  and 3) milder GPU power upgrades extended in 2027: 
we believe it is premature to confirm the Rubin Ultra upgrade at this stage as the 
chipset is designed for 3,500W+ peak power and the component supply chain still has 9 
months to improve the specs to meet the requirement on the system level design. 
Undershoot from unfounded concerns provides good entry 
We keep our Buy rating on Chroma with NT$3,050 PO based on 38x 2027 P/E and 
maintain our ‘26/'27 EPS estimate at NT$46.73/80.05. While the near term sentiment is 
dragged by the investor concerns on CPO and HVDC (800V) upgrade push out, we would 
note the timeframe is largely consistent with our view earlier this year and see the 
current valuation compelling at 25x ’27 P/E well backed by sales/EPS +59%/+75% CAGR.

Company Sector 
Semiconductor Capital Equipment

Company Description 
Chroma is a world leading provider of automated test 
equipment (ATE) and precision measurement solutions 
with 4,300+ system installed globally. Founded in 1984, the 
company has built a one of a kind diversified technology 
portfolio spanning semiconductor testers, power 
electronics testers, battery formation systems, photonics 
test instruments.

Investment Rationale 
We have a Buy rating on Chroma, in view of its strong 
technology leadership in the high power testing and 
complex semiconductor testing equipment. It has a solid 
position working with Nvidia for more than a decade and is 
seeing growing traction from AMD and hyperscalers' ASIC 
for system level testing and metrology tools. Longer term, 
the company could further expand its addressable market 
leveraging the technology in its existing product portfolio 
for co-packaged optics, panel level packaging.

### Page 4

Price objective basis & risk 
Chroma ATE (CRMJF) 
Our price objective of NT$3,050 on Chroma is based on 38x 2027E P/E, which is at the 
top of the company's historical trading range of 12-39x. In our view, the valuation 
multiple is underpinned by 
1) +70% earnings CAGR in 2025-27E supported by +75% sales CAGR growth and 
GMs/OpMs expanding, 2) ROE expansion to around 35% in 2025-27E, 3) net cash of 
around NT$21/share, and 4) free cash flow generation of around NT$15/share per 
annum across 2025-27E.

Downside risks to our price objective are: 
1) weaker market demand, especially the cloud AI investment moderation, leading to 
slower infrastructure builds especially in China and dragging the company's revenue 
growth for its power testing equipment business and operating leverage 
2) a more conservative investment cycle from the hyperscalers on further data center 
deployment due to growing capex could dampen the demand for GPU and ASIC, 
negatively impacting the testing equipment demand for related chipsets. 
3) failure to execute on the customized equipment requested by its customers or delay 
of technology roadmap could lead to an order shift to its competitors.

Novatek

Enhanced margin profile and share gain 
offset by still muted consumer demand

Reiterate Rating: NEUTRAL | PO: 550.00 TWD | Price: 543.00 TWD

2Q26 margin beat on more favorable mix and pricing  
2Q26 sales were bolstered by customers’ pull-in demand across DDIC and SoC, ahead of 
anticipated component price hike. 2Q26 GM improved by 340 bps QoQ to 42.4% (vs. 
BofAe 39.5%) on inflationary costs pass through, more favorable product mix, and 
benefit from low-cost inventory. Strong sales and solid GM took 2Q26 EPS to NT$10.40 
(vs. BofAe/street of NT$7.66/7.65) 
3Q26 sales driven by smartphone replenishment  
The company guided 3Q26 sales to +7% QoQ at the mid-point, with strong growth in 
smartphone driver IC replenishment demand and solid edge AI related SoC shipment 
partly offsetting by soft demand in large driver IC. Components order pull-in from NB 
brands in 1H26 should lead to moderation in procurement activity in 2H26. 3Q26 GMs 
midpoint of 40% slightly down from 2Q26 as tailwind from low-cost inventory fade.  
iPhone share gain and higher SoC mix support 2026/27  
We now forecast Novatek's sales to grow +10%/+10% YoY in 2026/27, mainly supported 
by share gain in iPhone OLED DDIC supply (see Korea analyst Simon Woo’s report), 
steady ramp in edge AI vision related SoC. With successful pricing adjustments to reflect 
rising manufacturing costs across all product line, coupled with mix shift toward margin 
accretive SoC segment, GMs should lift to 40.7%/39.5% in 2026/27. (vs. 37.7% in 2025) 
Stay Neutral on mixed demand outlook 
We lift our 2026/27/28 EPS estimates from NT$29.17/34.08/36.57 to 
NT$34.63/37.03/38.90, to factor in better pricing and margin assumptions. We raise our 
PO from NT$460 to NT$550, now based on 15x 2027 P/E (was 13x 2027 P/E), given 
enhanced margin profile and market position, but stay Neutral given demand softness in 
consumer electronic still lingers.

Company Sector 
Semiconductors

Company Description 
Founded in 1997, Novatek is a worldwide leading display 
driver IC design company. Its product offering encompasses 
flat panel display driver ICs (DDI), timing controller ICs (T-
CON), video processing SoC such as LCD monitor scaler, TV 
SoC, DSC, STB controller IC, TDDI and OLED drivers. The 
company has over 30% market share in large-size driver IC 
market and 10+% market share in small-to-medium display 
driver IC market.

Investment Rationale 
We rate Novatek as Neutral as we like its resilience in gross 
margin, dividend yield and position in high-end (OLED) 
DDIC market, vs the cautiousness held for the demand 
outlook and lack of spec upgrades in most of the consumer 
products (TV, PC, smartphone).

### Page 5

Price objective basis & risk 
Novatek (NVKMF) 
Our PO of NT$550 is based on 15x 2027E P/E, which is in the upper half of the 
historical trading range of 5-21x over the past ten years, with firmer recovery from the 
cycle bottom in the foreseeable future. The 15x target multiple is underpinned by (1) its 
market-share gain across most of its product lines, including TV SoC, LDDIC and OLED 
DDI, (2) solid position in high-end TDDI, (3) new business opportunities like ASIC, and (4) 
solid cashflow generation and balance sheet, with NT$80+ net cash/share on hand.

Upside risks to our PO are 1) better-than-expected demand in smartphone/PC/TV end-
markets, 2) faster progress into the new businesses with higher ASP.

Downside risks to our PO are 1) tougher-than-expected competition in OLED DDI as 
competitors catch up in technology, 2) faster-than-expected commoditization of TDDI 
squeezing profit margins.

Acer Inc.  | Asia Pacific
2Q26 OpM missed our estimate
but was in line with the Street;
stay UW
2Q details:
• GM was 11.4% (+20bps q/q, +130bps y/y), slightly (10bps) below our
estimate, but 20bps above the Street. The improvement likely came from
better pricing power, which we mentioned in our Lenovo report.
• Opex of NT$7.3bn, higher than our NT$6.6bn estimate.
• Thus, OP was NT$1,783mn (+122% q/q, +143% y/y), 14% below our estimate,
but in line with the Street. OpM was 2.1% (+100bps q/q, +100bps y/y), 70bps

below our estimate, but in line with the Street.
• However, non-op income of NT$2,107mn was higher than our estimate/the
Street,  consisting mainly of FX gains (NT$332mn) and investment income
(NT$377mn).
• Therefore, NP  was NT$2,172mn (+209% q/q, +100% y/y), 49% above our
estimate and 51% above the Street, for EPS of NT$0.72.
Stay UW: We have turned more positive on OEMs' pricing power, but Acer remains
the OEM that has low-end and consumer exposure, making it harder to be defensive

on units and price, relative  to OEMs with higher commercial/enterprise exposure.
We view  CY27 P/E of 19x  as unattractive, compared to regional peers like Lenovo
(rated OW) at <12x F28e P/E.

Idea
Remain OW and move to Top Pick:  We remain confident in S-SiCap, which is in
structural supply shortage (link), and VHM opportunities helped by edge AI (link).
Our new price target implies 2027e P/E of 47x and 2028e P/E of 26x; the 2028e P/
E    is roughly in line with the historical average since 2020.
2Q26 earnings beat: See Results recap                 .
Business update and outlook:
•  IoTRAM: 2Q revenue was NT$1.69bn, helped by stronger demand from

display customers. Management expects strong demand momentum, as
some customers shift from commodity memory to IoTRAM due to elevated
pricing. IoTRAM pricing was also increased in view of rising costs.
• S-SiCap: 2Q revenue was NT$640mn, as multiple cases have entered mass
production. IPD is entering an unprecedented rapid mass production ramp
supporting new embedded-in-substrate application for AI/HPC, with demand
visibility into 2028.  IPC production is set to resume in 4Q after potential

disruption in 3Q from the sale of PSMC's Tongluo fab. LSC has also entered
stable mass production. S-SiCap's revenue may exceed IoTRAM's in 2027.
• VHM: 2Q revenue was NT$37mn, mainly NRE. VHM is expected to enter
mass production in 2028. The first 8-high VHM is going through
qualification, with mass production expected around the end of 2027/ early
2028.
Other takeaways: AP Memory has entered  long-term capacity agreements with
major foundry and OSAT partners to secure wafer supply and OSAT capacity, and

expects to pay  deposits or prepayments to the partners. A GDR issuance has been
proposed, of up to 15mn shares (no more than 8.43% dilution),  for working capital
needs as the company sees strong growth opportunities.

2Q revenue was NT$2.4bn, +13% Q/Q, +78% Y/Y, 5% above our estimate, driven by

2Q IoTRAM/S-SiCap/VHM revenue mix was 71%/27%/2%.

estimate, helped by a more favorable customer mix.
2Q EPS was NT$4.18, +1% Q/Q, 5% above our estimate. Non-operating P&L included
mainly FX losses, interest income, and revaluation of financial assets.

Estimate revisions summary
We  raise our EPS estimates  3% for 2027 and 7% for 2028: We factor in 2Q26 actual
results. We also raise our shipment estimates for IoTRAM products  to factor in the
spillover demand from commodity memory as commodity memory pricing remains
elevated. We assume a higher growth rate for S-SiCap to account for the progress the
company has made in volume ramp-up and strong guidance from  management.

Valuation Methodology and Risks
Macronix International Co Ltd (2337.TW)
Base case, P/B, in line with our Greater China memory coverage, due to the memory industry's
cyclical nature. We apply a target multiple of 7.0x to our 2026 BVPS estimate, vs. its historical
average of 1.5x since 2017. We continue to believe the P/B target is justifiable, as The MLC and
legacy TLC NAND could be in greater shortage into 2H26, with under supply easily going up

to 40%. The only supplier which could fill the gap remains Macronix.
Risks to Upside
n Wider legacy NAND supply / demand gap
n NOR up-cycle, driven by limited supply expansion and/or stronger demand
n Faster growth for Switch hardware and core titles
Risks to Downside
n Less severe legacy NAND supply / demand gap
n NOR down-cycle, driven by faster supply expansion and/or demand weakness
n Slower growth for Switch hardware and core titles

Analyst Stock Ratings
Overweight (O). The stock's total return is expected to exceed the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next
12-18 months.
Equal-weight (E). The stock's total return is expected to be in line with the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over

the next 12-18 months.
Not-Rated (NR). Currently the analyst does not have adequate conviction about the stock's total return relative to the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage
universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next 12-18 months.
Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

12-18 months.
Unless otherwise specified, the time frame for price targets included in Morgan Stanley Research is 12 to 18 months.
Analyst Industry Views
Attractive (A): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be attractive vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated
below.
In-Line (I): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be in line with the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.

Cautious (C): The analyst views the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months with caution vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.
Benchmarks for each region are as follows: North America - S&P 500; Latin America - relevant MSCI country index or MSCI Latin America Index; Europe - MSCI Europe; Japan - TOPIX; Asia -

King Slide Works Co. Ltd.  | Asia Pacific
2Q26 Beat on 87% GM;
Momentum Sustaining Into
2H26
Another set of solid results to reassure the market about its
earnings sustainability, entrenched by its dominant industry
position. Stay OW.
2Q26  GM strong beat:
• Off revenue of NT$10,830mn (+99% QoQ/+156% YoY),  GM expanded 9.7ppt
QoQ to 87.4%  (vs. MSe/consensus at 78.1%/74.7%), which we think was
mainly driven by a more favorable product mix.

• Opex was NT$578mn (opex ratio 5.3%), lower than our estimate of NT
$707mn (opex ratio 6.5%) and  consensus of NT$494mn (opex ratio 5.5%)
• Operating profit came in at NT$8,890mn (+143% QoQ/+200% YoY; OPM
+15ppt QoQ to 82.1%), 15% higher than MSe of NT$7,751mn (OPM 71.6%) and
43% higher than consensus of NT$6,208mn (OPM 69.2%).
• With non-op gains of NT$229mn, including FX loss of NT$58mn, net profit
was NT$7,088mn (EPS NT$74.38), 14%/42% above MSe/consensus  at NT

$6,216mn (EPS NT$65.22)/NT$4,981mn (EPS NT$53.59).
• July revenue  was NT$6,407mn (+44% MoM/+356% YoY). QTD revenue
reached 52% of MSe at NT$12,232mn (+13% QoQ/+180% YoY) and 68% of
consensus at NT$9,427mn (-13% QoQ/+116% YoY).
Our view:
• Once again, King Slide has demonstrated earnings growth sustainability,
supported by its dominant industry position, against concerns over its
market share and profitability. We think this could enhance the market

conviction on its growth outlook ahead.
• While the 87.4% GM in 2Q26 was phenomenal, we would like to reiterate
that King Slide's earnings growth looks more driven by revenue growth than
margin expansion.
• Looking into 2H26, we think the strong July monthly sales indicate
momentum should sustain to drive another quarter of impressive sequential
growth on the top line vs. recent market expectations of 20-30% QoQ.
• 2Q26 earnings call at 2pm HKT on Aug 7th.

Valuation Methodology and Risks
King Slide Works Co. Ltd. (2059.TW)
Base case, 30x 2027e P/E. We use price/earnings as our valuation methodology because we
believe it better captures King Slide's earnings growth potential. We believe our target mul-
tiple is justified by an operating profit CAGR of 56% seen for 2025-28, implying a PEG of 0.5
vs. the average of 1.2 over 2010-24, when the stock was trading at 17-18x P/E with an operating

profit CAGR of 14%.
Risks to Upside
n Stronger-than-expected AI capex
n Stronger server demand
n Faster market share gains
Risks to Downside
n Softer AI capex
n Weaker server demand
n Sluggish kitchen furniture demand
n Competition leading to slower share gains.

ab 6 August 2026
Global Research
First Read
Accton Technology Corporation
Trianium 3 and 800G  ramp driving H226 growth
Q226 ahead on better sales
Accton reported Q226 EPS of NT$19.78, ahead of UBS/Consensus estimates on stronger
topline growth and better margins. Q226 sales of NT$95.5bn was up 36% QoQ, ahead
of its original guidance of ~20% QoQ primarily driven by stronger pull in for 800G cloud
switch for its new social media customer and  faster ramp of Trainium 3 AI card. Q226

GM of 19.7% was up 0.2ppts QoQ on better product mix  and greater revenue scale,
resulting in OPM of 15.0% (+0.7ppts QoQ) on operating leverage (OPEX  grew 23%
QoQ including bonus accrual). We estimate data center switch accounted for 36% of
Q226 sales (vs 31% Q126), while accelerator card was 50% of total sales (53% Q126).
Q326 sales should continue to expand, despite component supply constraint
Accton expects Q326 sales to   improve QoQ with July sales reported at flattish MoM,

suggesting  25%+ QoQ growth,  above UBSe/consensus expectations. Management
noted the robust sale momentum  is supported by the continued ramp of Trainium 3 and
800G cloud switch deployment by its major customer and new social media customer.
Nevertheless, Accton noted it continued to see component supply constraint (ASIC IC,
PCB, MLCC, memory, etc.), which is capping its  near-term order fulfilment. We forecast
Accton's Q326 sales to grow 30% QoQ, while GM may arrive at 19.4% (-0.3ppt QoQ)

on mix change (AI card has lower GM), leading to OPM of 15.2% (+0.2ppt QoQ).
Increase value-add and new project ramps supporting 2027E momentum
We see multiple drivers supporting Accton to further increase its value-adds into 2027E,
on top of better shipments for AI cards and cloud switch businesses. We expect its ASP
for Trainium 3 to further increase from Q426-2027E, driven by the adoption of liquid
cooling in selective designs. We believe Accton's content in Trainium 4 (pilot in Q427)

should further increase on more complicated board design, further adoption of liquid
cooling, and potential CPO/NPO adoption. For the cloud switch business, we believe it is
working with its social media customer for ramping Nvidia's Spectrum 6 switch and
could potentially start to see revenue contribution from 2027E, while the ongoing speed
migration (800G/1.6T), supplying of switch trays, and introduction of OCS (Optical
Circuit Switch) will further increase Accton's content value. We also expect L11 server

rack  to see more meaningful sales contribution in 2027, versus minimal 2026.
Valuation: Reiterate Buy with NT$3,688 PT
We raise our 2026-28E EPS by +10%/2%/4% on stronger sales outlook for AI card /
cloud switch and better margins. We retain Buy rating and NT$3,688 PT, based on 26x
average 2027-28E PE (from 27x) on market valuation contraction, still in the upper half
of its historical 10-31x range and supported by a 52% EPS CAGR in 2025-28E. Stock has

pulled back 14% from recent peak and is trading at 20.7x 2027E PE. We believe the
stock should further re-rate on accelerating EPS growth from H226, Nvidia  CPO switch
ramp for new customer, and  potential opportunities in OCS.

Company Description
Founded in 1988, Accton specialises in ODM/OEM solutions for data center switches, AI
accelerator cards, enterprise/ODM switches, carrier access/telecom and others. Accton is one
of the largest vendors of white-box and OCP-compliant switches globally (by sales).
Leveraging deep expertise in high-speed switching, system integration and rapid time-to-

market, it has secured long-term partnerships with major cloud service providers.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
We value Accton using PE methodology.
Key risks include: 1) weaker-than-expected demand for data center switches; 2) slower ramp
of 800G and 1.6T data center switches; 3) market share loss in the AI accelerator card
business; and 4) softer gross margin than expected.

underlying asset. Depending on the terms of the investment, investors could lose all or a substantial portion of their investment based on the performance of the underlying
asset. Investors could also lose their entire investment if the issuer becomes insolvent. UBS does not guarantee in any way the obligations or the financial condition of any

issuer or the accuracy of any financial information provided by any issuer. Structured investments are not traditional investments and investing in a structured investment is
not equivalent to investing directly in the underlying asset. Structured investments may have limited or no liquidity, and investors should be prepared to hold their investment
to maturity. The return of structured investments may be limited by a maximum gain, participation rate or other feature. Structured investments may include call features and,

if a structured investment is called early, investors would not earn any further return and may not be able to reinvest in similar investments with similar terms. Structured
investments include costs and fees which are generally embedded in the price of the investment. The tax treatment of a structured investment may be complex and may differ
from a direct investment in the underlying asset. UBS and its employees do not provide tax advice. Investors should consult their own tax advisor about their own tax situation

## Document 140: 260807_ms_kingslide

Source PDF: all report pdf/260807_ms_kingslide.pdf
Report source: line報告備份
Date: 2026-08-07
Pages: 16
Extraction status: ok

### Page 1

M
Idea
Is the revenue growth momentum sustainable? Yes:  King Slide posted solid
monthly sales of NT$6,407mn (+44% MoM/+356% YoY) in July. To put this into
perspective, this monthly run rate was 3.3x vs. that in March 2026 (NT$1,918mn,
+9% MoM/+39% YoY). Though management did not provide numerical guidance on
the call, it indicates that it is seeing broad-based strong customer demand  with good
order visibility across a wide range of applications in both data center and enterprise

environments. Because of its comprehensive patent portfolio and solid execution,
King Slide  should remain the go-to supplier in most relevant projects. Therefore, we
now expect revenue to  step up further in 3Q26, to NT$19,555mn (+81% QoQ/+348%
YoY).
What's the margin outlook? Confident: The 87.4% GM (+9.7ppt QoQ) for 2Q26
was remarkable. Management cited a more favorable product mix – it shipped
plenty of new products, which usually carry higher margins thanks to more

complicated design. Management believes that  rail kit technology will continue to
advance –  and King Slide is able to better address those needs through accumulated
knowledge to efficiently move  design concepts into manufacturable products.
Furthermore, the product life cycle has shortened to 6-12 months from 12-24
months in the past, which will pose more challenges for the supply chain – but at
the same time, position leading players like King Slide well to offer more  value. As a

result, management sounds confident about its margin outlook in coming years.
Does King Slide have enough capacity? It's coming: This is another natural
question for a company showing such robust growth in a short period. Management
indicated that it has been squeezing more output from its existing facilities through
equipment/automation upgrades and more work shifts; utilization is 70-80%  now.
Aside from existing plants, it will have US capacity coming online this September/

October and a new factory in Kaohsiung in 2H27. Last, it might kick off another
project in late 2026 in Kaohsiung next to its existing one that could accommodate a
greenfield factory – potentially tripling its existing capacity when fully operational.
Stay OW: We maintain the view that King Slide's competitiveness is well entrenched
and accentuated amid quick generation migration. The stock has rallied very
strongly, yet we believe the earnings outlook can sustain valuation.

Valuation Methodology
Our price target (base case scenario value) is NT$15,000 (previously NT$10,000):  It is
derived from our  target P/E of 30x 2027e (unchanged).
We use P/E as our valuation methodology because we believe it better captures King
Slide's earnings growth potential. We believe our 30x target P/E multiple is justified by an
operating profit CAGR of 77% for 2025-28 in our estimates, implying a PEG of 0.4 vs. the
average of 1.1 over 2010-25, when the stock traded at 18x P/E  with an operating profit

CAGR of 18%.
Bull case scenario value – NT$20,000 (vs. NT$13,000 previously): We apply a 40x
multiple to our base case estimate for 2027 (unchanged). Our bull case mainly reflects
stronger demand for server rail kits owing to heavy server capex and spec upgrades driven
by the secular AI trend.
Bear case scenario value – NT$7,500 (vs. NT$5,000 previously): We apply a 15x
multiple to our base case estimate for 2027 (unchanged). Our bear case mainly reflects

lukewarm data center demand amid softening IT capex budgets and pricing pressure for
server components without spec upgrades.

ab 7 August 2026
Global Research
King Yuan Electronics
Riding on expanding TAM of Cloud AI volume
even with less growth in test time
Sales growth to accelerate in Q4 after softer Q3
We forecast KYEC’s Q3 sales to grow high single digits QoQ, below consensus estimate
of 16-17% QoQ. Q3 gross margin may also decline to 38-39% from 39.5% in Q2, due
to higher electricity and labor cost, and 1% dilution from the new Singapore fab. The
major Cloud AI accelerators are ramping up in Q3, albeit still in early stage. We expect

multiple Cloud AI accelerator programs to ramp meaningfully in Q4, to lift sales growth
to 15-20% QoQ. We estimate Q4 GM to also rise to 42-43% with higher utilization and
lower utility cost.
Larger Cloud AI TAM to support 2027E sales growth of 45%
Looking ahead, KYEC has planned clean room construction through end of 2027,
reflecting the rising testing demand from probing and final test from growing units of
server CPU, accelerators, networking etc. On final test time, the content for new major

Cloud AI accelerator may be flat to up slightly vs prior generation based on our estimate,
likely given the tight testing capacity and limited architectural change. Net, we forecast
KYEC’s sales to grow 45% in 2027E after 36% growth in 2026E.
Diversifying footprint in Singapore and the US
Given the geopolitical dynamics, KYEC is also enhancing its supply resilience by
diversifying its production base. The new Singapore fab just started mass production in

Q226. KYEC also recently announced its plan for the US expansion . In terms of
implication to profitability, our view is the dilution should be manageable if KYEC could
negotiate with key clients for tool consignment.
Valuation: Buy with lower target of NT$325
We lower 2026/27/28E EPS by 11-15% to factor in less meaningful increase of final test
time of Cloud AI chips, MediaTek’s TPU v8t order split with ASE, and higher OPEX
assumption. We lower our price target to NT$325 from NT$380, based on unchanged

22x 2027E PE. Maintain Buy rating.

near term, usually in response to an event that may affect the investment case or valuation. Equity Price Targets have an investment

Investing in structured investments involves significant risks. For a detailed discussion of the risks involved in investing in any particular structured investment, you must read

the relevant offering materials for that investment. Structured investments are unsecured obligations of a particular issuer with returns linked to the performance of an
underlying asset. Depending on the terms of the investment, investors could lose all or a substantial portion of their investment based on the performance of the underlying
asset. Investors could also lose their entire investment if the issuer becomes insolvent. UBS does not guarantee in any way the obligations or the financial condition of any

issuer or the accuracy of any financial information provided by any issuer. Structured investments are not traditional investments and investing in a structured investment is
not equivalent to investing directly in the underlying asset. Structured investments may have limited or no liquidity, and investors should be prepared to hold their investment
to maturity. The return of structured investments may be limited by a maximum gain, participation rate or other feature. Structured investments may include call features and,

if a structured investment is called early, investors would not earn any further return and may not be able to reinvest in similar investments with similar terms. Structured
investments include costs and fees which are generally embedded in the price of the investment. The tax treatment of a structured investment may be complex and may differ
from a direct investment in the underlying asset. UBS and its employees do not provide tax advice. Investors should consult their own tax advisor about their own tax situation

before investing in any securities.

12-18 months.
Equal-weight (E). The stock's total return is expected to be in line with the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over

the next 12-18 months.
Not-Rated (NR). Currently the analyst does not have adequate conviction about the stock's total return relative to the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage
universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next 12-18 months.
Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

12-18 months.

### Page 2

2Q26 results in line: Revenues is pre-announced; GM increased to 9.3%, better than our 
and Bloomberg consensus of 8.5% / 8.4%, leading GP to +23% QoQ,  9% / 10% ahead of 
our / Bloomberg consensus. We attribute the higher GM to (1) general servers turning to 
consign business models from Buy & Sell, (2) better product mix, with general servers 
revenues contribution over 50%, and (3) more NRE fees given major customer’s new 
ASIC AI servers. Nevertheless, opex ratio up to 2%, higher than our / Bloomberg 
consensus of 1.3% / 1.5%, leading OP income to +16% QoQ, or 1% / 4% ahead of our / 
Bloomberg consensus, largely in line. The higher opex ratio is mainly on R&D 
investments, as the company’s expansion toward AI servers, with potential ASIC AI 
servers SKUs expansion, and AI servers expanding from ASIC-powered to GPU-powered.

Earnings revision: We factor in 2Q26 results and July revenues, and change our net 
income by -2% / +0% / +4% in 2026-28E. The change is mainly on revenues: (1) we cut 
2026E revenues by 6%, reflecting the general servers turning to consign business model, 
general servers strong pull in in 1H26, and most new products (e.g. GPU AI server racks, 
the new liquid-cooled ASIC AI servers) are in 4Q26, (2) we raise 2027-28E revenues by 
2% / 5%, reflecting the ramp up of new AI server products, and the company’s potential 
of new ASIC AI servers customers expansion.

Price Target Risks and Methodology - Wiwynn 
We are Buy-rated on Wiwynn with a 12-month TP of NT$10,000. Our target price is 
based on 20x 2027E P/E, which is derived from PC/server peers’ EPS growth vs. P/E 
multiple correlation. We see EPS growth as a major factor for the stock’s performance. 
Key downside risks: 1) weaker-than-expected AI server demand growth; 2) 
slower-than-expected recovery in general server demand; and 3) more severe 
competition in the server ODM market.

  【投資評等說明】  
  評等  定義  
  強力買進 (Strong Buy)  首次評等潛在上漲空間 ≥ 35%  
  買進 (Buy)  15% ≤首次評等潛在上漲空間 <35%  
  區間操作 (Trading Buy) 5% ≤首次評等潛在上漲空間 <15%

中立 (Neutral)  
無法由基本面給予投資評等  
預期近期股價將處於盤整  
建議降低持股

【投資評等調整機制】  
  投資評等係「首次」給予特定個股投資評等時，其前一日收盤價相較 3 個月
目標價之潛在上漲空間計算而得。個股投資評等分為四個等級，定義如上。
爾後的投資評等係依循「首次評等」，直到停止推薦。   
「強力買進」、「買進」及「區間操作」均有 upside 目標價。差別僅在於，
首次評等時潛在報酬率不同。「中立」則無目標價。  
一旦我們給予特定個股「強力買進」 、 「買進」或「區間操作」之投資評等，
就是責任的開始，爾後將透過各式研究報告作定期性、持續性追蹤基本面及
股價變化，直到停止推薦。  
停止推薦情境：  
1.  達目標價。  
2.  雖未達原訂目標價，但檢視基本面、訊息面、籌碼面等多方訊息，研
判股價上漲空間已然有限，將適時出具降評報告。  
3.  推薦後股價不漲反跌。

【免責聲明】  
  本研究報告僅提供予特定人之客戶作為參考資料「非經同意不得轉載」 。我
們並不確保此資訊的完整性與正確性，投資人應了解，報告中有關未來預測
之陳述可能不會實現，因而不應被依賴。而且此報告並非根據特定投資目的
或依預定對象之財務狀況所撰寫出來的，因此，此研究報告的目的，既非對
投資人於買賣證券、選擇權、期貨或其他證券相關之衍生性商品提供詢價服
務，亦非作為進行交易的要約。投資人應注意到相關證券之價值及收益，可
能會有無預警地上升或下降，產生投資回報金額可能比原始投資來得少的
情形。

營收走勢圖

研究員/吳大任 TERRY.WU@uni-psg.com

研究部對譜瑞投資建議維持中立，係因(1)2Q26 毛利率再探底，獲
利不如預期，(2)3Q26 營收展望符合預期，惟毛利率有下修疑慮，
(3)ASIC LIKE 產品 4Q27 才會貢獻營收，比市場預期稍晚，(4)成
本提升速度快於調整產品價格 ， 故毛利率預測再下修 ， 連帶下修26
年獲利預估 。 綜合以上 ， 下修譜瑞26 年 EPS 預估為 32.99 元(原估
35.74 元，-4.4%YOY)，預估 27 年 EPS 為 38.19 元(+15.8%YOY)。
因毛利率預估下修 ， 加上此次法說會較少提到ACC 相關產品 ， 另外
ASIC LIKE 出貨時間點比市場預期晚，故仍維持中立投資建議，目
標價 678 元(27 年EPS *18XPER)。

重點摘要： 
1. 2Q26 毛利率再探底，獲利不如預期 
2Q26 譜瑞-KY 營收為落在財測區間約中間的 42.49 億元，
成長 6.5%QOQ， 成長3.3%YOY， 約略與原先預估的42.08 億
元相差不大。不過毛利率僅為 40.2%，相對先前預估的
41.2%有所差距 ， 主要係因譜瑞受到成本端漲價 ， 雖然有反
映出去，但不如成本提升的速度快所致。在毛利率不如預
期的狀況下，使得稅後淨利僅為 5.93 億元(原估 6.42 億
元)，成長 12.1%QOQ，衰退 15.5%YOY，EPS 7.51 元(原估
8.02 元)。2Q26 營收占比來看：DP(Display port, TCON) 
約 30%以上，PS(High speed) 約 45%，TC(DRIVER)10%以
下，TT(Touch) 約 15%。

2. 3Q26 展望符合預期，希望毛利率回升：  
譜瑞-KY 3Q26 給出營收 1.39 億至 1.53 億美元，成長
3.4%QOQ-成長 13.8%QOQ，隱含區間中值約成長 8.6%QOQ，
其中產品線中表現最好的將會是 TT，因為 TTED 產品銷售
狀況優於預期，產品在市場上目前無競爭對手所致；毛利
率介於40%至44%， 公司寄望2Q26 為全年毛利率低點 ，3Q26
將持續反映成本給客戶且優化產品設計，以提升毛利率。
營業費用約 3,300 萬至 3,600 萬美元。整體財測營收與先
前預估相當 ， 但毛利率仍有所下修 ， 故研究部預估3Q26 營
收為 47.21 億元(原估 46.8 億元)，成長 11.1%QOQ，成長
7.9%YOY，毛利率下修預估至 40.8%(原估 42.2%)，稅後淨
利同步下修預估為 7.85 億元(原估 8.41 億元)，成長
32.4%QOQ，衰退 3.7%YOY，EPS 9.94 元(原估 10.5 元)。

### Page 2

請參見末頁重要批露及免責聲明  2

3. 26 年成長性最高的產線來自於 TT 
2Q26 進入量產的 TTED 產品，因為貢獻幅度大於預期，使
得 2Q26 TT 產線提升至約當 15%。在法說會中，譜瑞表示，
原先預估該產品今年出貨量約高於 500 萬顆，但因為目前
產品仍無競爭對手，加上在帶筆觸控也開始與日本廠商合
作，故認為今年出貨量預估將提升至遠超過 500 萬顆。最
終目標譜瑞認為將可以達到整體筆電的 10%，約當是年出
貨量 1500 萬顆。綜合以上，推估譜瑞TT 產線營收將成長
約 50%YOY 以上。

4. ASIC LIKE 產品量產時間點將在 4Q27： 
譜瑞切入 CHIPSET 產品此次法說會也有證實，雖未提及
客戶名稱，但譜瑞表示目前有兩個產品進行研發，應該
會在今年下半年 TAPE OUT 產品。產品單價約在 10-20 美
元左右，而毛利率仍取決於產品良率，目前應該與公司
平均相近，未來將持續優化。而研究部目前仍以較保守
方式預估貢獻幅度，係因市場原估貢獻時間點落在
1H27，但現在可能要往後挪移至 4Q27 貢獻。

5. 26年獲利仍有下修風險，27年正向看待：  
有鑒於譜瑞2Q26營收符合預期，但毛利率仍受到壓抑，使
得獲利不如預期。而 3Q26財測營收也約略與先前預估相
當，但獲利仍有微幅下修，故研究部維持 26年營收預估
173.4億元(原估174.4億元)， 成長4.9%YOY， 但因為毛利率
下修故同步下修稅後淨利預估為 26.05億元(原估28.6億
元)， 衰退4.4%YOY，EPS 32.99元(原估35.7元)。 展望27年，
成本雖然可能持續提升，不過譜瑞 TTED持續放量，加上
ASIC LIKE產品即將出貨，故預估27年營收為187億元，成
長8.3%YOY，稅後淨利預估為30.17億元，成長15.8%YOY，
EPS 38.19元。

資 標 的 ， 或 文 中 所 討 論 或 建 議 之 投 資 策 略 ， 投 資 人 應 就 其 是 否 適 合 本 身 財 務 狀 況 與
